title: AI / Software Engineering Intern
description:
**AI / Software Engineering Intern**

A paid 6-month internship building production software for industry clients. Work on real-world problems with the engineering team. Overlap required with US and Australian time zones.

**About the role**

aiqon is hiring AI / Software Engineering Interns for a paid, 6-month internship. You'll work on real-world problems for industry clients (not throwaway intern projects) and ship software that people actually use.

This is a hands-on role. You'll ship code, review pull requests, debug production issues, and learn how a small team designs, builds, and iterates. Depending on the project, you may work on product features, APIs, data pipelines, or AI-powered tools for client systems.

We're looking for people who have recently completed, or are about to complete, a degree in computer science, AI, or software engineering, who write clean code, think from first principles, and want to learn by building.

**Key responsibilities**

* Build and ship features on real-world systems for industry clients.
* Contribute to AI-powered features such as LLM integrations, retrieval pipelines, and tooling that makes those systems reliable.
* Write clear, maintainable code with tests; participate in code review and iterate based on feedback.
* Debug issues end-to-end, from UI to API to data, and document what you learn so the team can move faster.
* Collaborate with product and client stakeholders to turn operational needs into working software.
* Improve developer experience where you see friction: scripts, docs, types, and small infrastructure fixes.

**Requirements**

* Recently completed, or about to complete, a Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, AI/ML, Software Engineering, or a closely related field.
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript/JavaScript; you can write working software without being walked through every step.
* Comfort with Git, web fundamentals (HTTP, REST, HTML/CSS), and at least one modern framework (e.g. React, Node, or a Python web stack).
* Genuine interest in AI/ML and software engineering. You experiment, read docs, and ship small projects of your own.
* A GitHub, portfolio, or LinkedIn that shows work you have actually built.
* Clear written communication in English; you can explain trade-offs and ask for help early.
* Willing to work overlapping hours with US and Australian time zones.
* Available for a paid 6-month internship in hybrid, remote, or onsite (Hyderabad) mode.

*Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Thank you.*

title: Engineer III Software
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.
  
  
At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.
  
  
As we continue to scale our global platform, the Software Engineer III — Commerce Applications & Integrations will play a critical role in building and operating the applications that power our wholesale commerce experience end-to-end.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Software Engineer III — Commerce Applications & Integrations to build, operate, and continuously improve the applications that power our wholesale commerce experience — including product and catalog workflows, cart and checkout, order processing, account management, and the internal tools our operations teams rely on every day. This is a full-stack role with real end-to-end ownership spanning application development, APIs and integrations, data processing, cloud infrastructure, production support, incident resolution, security remediation, and operational readiness. The Software Engineer III — Commerce Applications & Integrations delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.
  
  
**How Will You Drive Impact**
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)
  
  

* Partner closely with Product, Business Operations, Platform, Security, Data, and Support teams to align on technical decisions, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and ship reliable solutions collaboratively.
* Contribute to architecture discussions, modernization initiatives, and technical discovery, bringing well-reasoned perspectives on schema design, system design, and next-generation commerce capabilities.
* Participate in production support rotations and serve as a dependable technical resource for time-sensitive ordering escalations and cross-functional issue resolution.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)
  
  

* Build and enhance wholesale commerce portal capabilities across catalog, cart, checkout, order confirmation, account, product, and user-experience workflows that customers and internal teams depend on daily.
* Support order and fulfillment business rules — including inventory availability, account configuration, ship-window and cancellation dates, and downstream order interfaces — to ensure a seamless ordering experience.
* Improve application reliability through monitoring, alerting, deployment health checks, and release validation so that customer-facing systems perform consistently and at scale.
* Participate in resolving customer access issues and account setup problems, reducing friction in the wholesale commerce experience.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
  
  

* Design and develop scalable APIs, integrations, and supporting services using Go, Python, Node.js, and React/TypeScript that keep end-to-end business workflows reliable and extensible.
* Develop scalable data-processing solutions for product, catalog, account, and order workloads, including batch and asynchronous processing pipelines built on AWS services such as SQS/SNS, EventBridge, and Lambda.
* Contribute to application modernization efforts, including schema migration, platform refactoring, and the adoption of infrastructure-as-code practices via Terraform and GitHub Actions.
* Explore and apply emerging tools, patterns, and AI-enabled capabilities to continuously improve the quality, efficiency, and scalability of commerce systems.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)
  
  

* Take end-to-end ownership of ambiguous problems through design, implementation, testing, release, and ongoing operational support across the full commerce application stack.
* Troubleshoot production issues using structured logs, metrics, distributed traces, application behavior, and data analysis; drive root-cause analysis and implement durable fixes rather than patches.
* Address application security and software supply-chain findings — including dependency vulnerabilities, authorization gaps, CI/CD hardening, and least-privilege access — with rigor and urgency.
* Reduce recurring production issues over time by improving monitoring, operational documentation, and the underlying reliability of data and integration workflows.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY
  
  
We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:
  
  

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**Required Qualifications**
CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
  
  

* 3–6 years of professional software engineering experience with a strong track record delivering production software as an individual contributor, including full-stack ownership across frontend, backend, APIs, integrations, data, and operational concerns.
* Proficiency with React and TypeScript for building customer-facing web applications, and proficiency in at least one backend language among Go, Python, or Node.js with willingness to work across the others.
* Production experience on AWS, including compute (ECS/EKS, Lambda), storage (S3), managed databases (RDS), and messaging services (SQS/SNS, EventBridge).
* Experience designing scalable APIs, data workflows, batch and asynchronous processing pipelines, and system integrations in a production environment.
* Strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills using logs, metrics, traces, and data, with the ability to implement durable fixes rather than short-term patches.
* Solid understanding of secure coding practices, dependency management, authorization models, secrets handling, and CI/CD security hardening.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to work effectively alongside product, business, platform, security, and support partners on ambiguous, end-to-end problems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in wholesale commerce, order management, catalog, product, inventory, or fulfillment domains.
* Exposure to Salesforce Lightning Web Components (LWC) or the broader Salesforce commerce ecosystem.
* Experience with relational database design, query optimization, and schema migration at scale using PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Experience with messaging and event-driven integration patterns such as Pub/Sub, SQS/SNS, Kafka, or EventBridge.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK) and GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD tooling.
* Experience with application modernization, architecture, or platform migration initiatives.

WORK LOCATION
  
  
Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in
**Hyderabad**
, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence IN-OFFICE SCHEDULE — Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday
  
  
*At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.*
**About Us**
*Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.*
**About The Team**
*Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally – as well as its flagship site, www.fanatics.com.*
*Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world—including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).*
*At Fanatics Commerce, we infuse our BOLD Leadership Principles in everything we do:*

* Build Championship Teams
* Obsessed with Fans
* Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit
* Determined and Relentless Mindset

title: Engineer - IT Software [T500-29964]
description:
**ANSR is hiring for one of its clients.**

To Care for People on Life's Journey®. Together with our American Eagle regional partners, we offer thousands of flights daily to more than 350 destinations in more than 60 countries.

American Airlines is transforming the way it delivers technology to its customers and team members worldwide.

title: Sr. Integrations Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

Web Integration Engineer | BrightEdge India

**Working hours**

**Aligned to US Eastern Time: 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM ET, which is 4:30 PM to 12:30 AM IST (April to November) or 5:30 PM to 1:30 AM IST (November to March). Occasional later calls with US Pacific customers.**

People with Mulesoft / SAP / any platform specific integration or non customer facing experience need not apply. This is a pure customer facing website integration role.

**Experience**

**3 to 8 years**

**About BrightEdge**

BrightEdge is the global market leader in enterprise SEO. Its all-in-one platform helps the world's leading brands turn organic search into a core revenue channel, from deep technical analysis to research and recommendations to scaled reporting and automation.

BrightEdge became the first company in the SEO space to automate SEO, using AI and machine learning to put optimisation to work directly on customers' websites. BrightEdge is profitable, growing, and expanding globally, and we are now building our team in India.

**About the Role**

As a Web Integration Engineer you are the technical owner of getting Brightedge live on our customers' websites. You will lead customers through requirements, scoping and solution design, work hands-on with their web developers, agencies and IT teams, and make sure each deployment goes live on time and works correctly.

This is a customer-facing technical role. A typical day includes 3 to 5 customer calls, internal team meetings, code configuration, presentation preparation and troubleshooting. You will work across many content management systems and websites, and with customers from a wide range of industries.

You will be one of the first members of the India Integration team, with the chance to shape how it works and to grow with it.

**What You Will Do**

* Lead customers through requirements gathering, full scoping and solution design for integration.
* Run customer calls and drive deliverables with demanding clients; provide the code and configuration needed for integration.
* Write design documents and technical specifications for the overall solution.
* Support integration testing, system testing and user acceptance testing.
* Own the deadline for each customer deployment, from planning and implementation through training, business adoption and change management.
* Advise clients on best practices for integration, data migration and website migrations.
* Work with customers' web developers, agencies and IT teams to align on deployment practices, and negotiate where needed.
* Manage many deployments at the same time, following the BrightEdge deployment process every time.
* Follow up after every call, keep Salesforce and internal systems current, and send customers their deliverables promptly.
* Identify performance, data-collection and process gaps, and feed them back to Product Management.
* Build blueprints and automation code, and evaluate tools that improve the deployment practice.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Brightedge is live on each customer's website within
  **45 days**
  of the deal closing.
* You comfortably handle at least
  **15 deployments in parallel**
  without compromising process.
* You follow the deployment process
  **100% of the time**
  , including Salesforce hygiene.
* You answer customer questions
  **within one business day**
  and act with a sense of urgency.
* You do what you say you will do, internally and externally.
* You learn the playbook quickly and use coaching and feedback to improve.
* You meet your quarterly MBOs.

**What You Bring**

**Required**

* 3 to 8 years of experience in web development combined with customer-facing roles (US or European customers preferred).
* At least 2 years of hands-on experience with a JavaScript framework such as React, Angular or Node.js.
* Solid understanding of at least one major programming language such as PHP, Ruby on Rails, ASP.NET, Python, Java or C++.
* Hands-on web development experience.
* Experience implementing websites or e-commerce sites for multiple customers at the same time.
* Experience leading customer calls and working with technical stakeholders from web developers to IT executives.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* A bachelor's degree (BE, B.Tech, B.Sc or similar, any discipline).
* Ability to work US Eastern Time hours.

**A plus**

* Experience with SEO or digital marketing.
* Background in a SaaS, platform or martech company.
* Experience with multiple CMS platforms and website migrations.
* Experience in a startup or early-stage environment.

**Who Will Thrive Here**

* **A self-starter with a can-do mindset**
  who wants to help build a new team.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity and change**
  , able to work in a mix of structured and unstructured settings, and able to pivot.
* **Process driven and coachable**
  , willing to adopt the BrightEdge playbook and take feedback.
* **Proactive problem solver**
  who acts with urgency and keeps a positive, professional demeanour with customers.
* **Accountable and organised**
  , able to prioritise many things at once.

This is an early-stage environment in India. Some people will find that exciting, and some will find it demanding. Either is fine; we want you to choose the role with open eyes.

**Why Join BrightEdge**

* Be among the first hires on a new India team, with direct impact on how it is built and a variety of career paths as it grows.
* Work with leading global brands across many industries and gain deep experience integrating a wide range of CMS platforms and websites.
* Work on technology that uses AI and machine learning to automate SEO, with a strong first-mover advantage.
* Join a profitable, market-leading company with strong leadership, a clear vision and plans for global expansion.
* A supportive culture where we work hard, have fun and care about our people, even in a hybrid setup.

*BrightEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.*

title: QA Engineering
description:
**The Opportunity: Build the future of Wealth**

In a fintech world obsessed with gamification and speculative betting, Endowus stands apart. We aren't here to build another trading app; we are building the financial infrastructure to help people achieve long-term life goals - retirement, education, and financial freedom.

**Headquartered in Singapore, we are the largest independent digital wealth platform in Asia**
. However, we are not a one-trick robo-advisor. We are a full-suite wealth platform spanning public equities, fixed income, private markets, and hedge funds. We provide clients with customized exposure—global, regional, or sectoral—across all their wealth (from liquid cash to pension savings) and for all their needs (from short-term cash management to long-term retirement planning).

Just six years after launch, we manage over US$10 Billion (~₹90,000 Crore) in assets for more than a quarter-million clients across Singapore and Hong Kong. We are a Series B company backed by global giants (Lightspeed, Illuminate, Prosus, EDBI, UBS), with ambitions to cover the entire region.

**This is not an 'offshore' support role.**
Our India team is a
**core product hub**
, operating on parity with our Singapore HQ. Engineers here drive end-to-end ownership of platform innovation. You won't just be testing code; you will be engineering the safety nets that allow us to move fast without breaking trust.

**The Role: Engineering Confidence**

Most companies treat QA as a final checkpoint. We treat it as an engineering discipline.

Our clients trust us with their life savings. "Move fast and break things" is not an option here. What we need is "Move fast and prove it's safe."

Here’s what you can look forward to in this role.

* **Engineer the Safety Net**
  : You will build and maintain scalable automation scripts that cover the entire stack - from Backend APIs (Scala/Akka) to Web (React) and Mobile (Flutter). You ensure our regression tests are reliable and fast.
* **Shift Quality Left**
  : You will collaborate with Product Managers and Developers before a line of code is written. You will review requirements for testability and ensure edge cases are caught during the design phase.
* **Pragmatic Quality**
  : While automation is our north star, we value thoughtful test planning and the human eye. You are willing to roll up your sleeves and perform manual exploratory testing because you know when to automate and when to test/investigate manually.
* **Drive CI/CD Velocity**
  : You will integrate your tests into our CI/CD pipelines. You ensure that our feedback loops are fast so developers can fix issues immediately.
* **Guardian of the Client Experience**
  : You will look beyond functional correctness. You will simulate real-world client behaviors to catch usability friction, performance lags, and data inconsistencies that automated checks might miss.

**Our Tech Stack**

* **Web Automation**
  : We use
  **Playwright**
  for high-speed, reliable end-to-end testing of our React applications.
* **Backend Automation**
  : We use
  **Cucumber-Scala**
  to test our distributed microservices (Scala/Akka) and ensure our domain logic holds up under pressure.
* **Mobile Automation**
  : We leverage
  **Maestro E2E**
  and flutter tests for our Dart/Flutter mobile apps.
* **Ops**
  : We are 100% cloud-native (AWS) and rely heavily on
  **CI/CD**
  to run your tests on every commit.

**Want to look under the hood?**
Read how we solve testing challenges on our Engineering Blog at
tech.endowus.com

**What Success Looks Like**

* **First 30 Days (Immersion)**
  : You understand our domain models and testing infrastructure. You have added a new regression test and performed manual testing for a new feature release.
* **First 90 Days (Ownership)**
  : You are actively writing automated tests for new features within the sprint. You have built a deep understanding of many domain flows and have plugged several gaps in our current test coverage.
* **First 6 Months (Impact)**
  : You now own the test planning & execution for major new initiatives and are actively elevating the quality of our platform with a “founder mentality”.

**What You Bring (Requirements)**

We care more about your engineering intuition than your ability to memorize APIs. However, this role requires a specific baseline:

**Must-Haves**
:

* **4+ Years of Test Engineering**
  : You have solid experience in automation. You are comfortable writing code to test code, but you also respect the value of manual validation.
* **Strong Coding Fundamentals**
  : You are proficient in at least one major language (
  **Java, Scala, TypeScript, or Python**
  ). You can read developer code to understand where a bug might be hiding.
* **Automation Framework Competence**
  : You have experience using and extending frameworks like
  **Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium**
  . You can write stable, maintainable scripts.
* **API Testing DNA**
  : You are comfortable testing microservices. You understand REST, JSON, and how to query a database (SQL) to verify test states.
* **Collaborative Mindset**
  : You don't wait for a "hand-off." You actively ask developers and PMs questions about implementation details to plan your tests better

**Nice-to-Haves**
:

* **Mobile Automation**
  : Experience testing Flutter or native apps using Appium or Maestro.
* **Performance Testing**
  : Experience with K6, Gatling, or JMeter.
* **FinTech Domain**
  : You understand financial concepts, ledgers, or high-security environments

**Why Endowus?**

* **Modern Stack, Serious Business**
  : You get to apply modern automation tools to mission-critical financial infrastructure. You get the intellectual depth of a top-tier private bank with the agility of a startup.
* **World-Class Engineering Talent**
  : You will work with colleagues from top product companies like Amazon, Google, Swiggy, Flipkart, Grab, and Meta. We bring together strong fintech DNA with the best of agile startup culture.
* **Career Growth with Upside**
  : We manage massive AUA ($10 billion and growing) with a lean, high-talent team (~85 in product engineering). This means high visibility, high impact, and significant ESOP upside in a company that is defining the category.
* **Leadership Pedigree**
  : Our leadership team brings experience from Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, UBS, McKinsey, Bloomberg, Amazon, Alibaba, Grab, Shopee, Salesforce, and more.

**Why NOT Endowus?**

We want you to thrive here, which means we must be honest about the environment.

* **You prefer 100% Automation**
  : If you thrive best when writing code all day and prefer to minimize manual exploration with the product or learning the domain inside-out, our hybrid approach might not suit you.
* **You prefer a Centralized QA Structure**
  : If you prefer working in a dedicated QA team with clear hand-offs from developers, you might find our cross-functional team structure (Backend + Frontend + QA + PM + Design) challenging.
* **You prefer executing over planning**
  : If you do your best work when given a pre-written test plan to execute step-by-step, this role might be too broad. We need engineers who can look at a feature spec and derive the test strategy themselves.
* **You want 100% Remote**
  : We work in the office at least 3 days a week because we believe in the serendipity of in-person collaboration

**The Interview Process**

We respect your time and aim to be thorough yet efficient.

* Recruiter Screen (30 min): Quick alignment on role, stack, and mission.
* Online Coding Assessment (90 min): A hands-on coding challenge to assess your coding and scripting fundamentals along with Test planning
* Technical Deep Dive (90 min): Live coding and discussion. We focus on automation logic, framework usage, and how you approach manual vs. automated scenarios.
* System Design (60 min): We talk about test strategies for distributed systems, API testing, and data management.
* Culture & Values (60 min): Meeting with Leadership to ensure we are a match.

title: AVP, Sr Product Engineer, APEX (L10)
description:

AVP, Sr Product Engineer, APEX (L10)
  
  
**Company Overview:**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.
  
  

* We have recently been ranked #2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid-Sized Companies, ranked #3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top-Rated Financial Services Companies.
* We provide best-in-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work-life integration and overall well-being.
* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities, for all to take up leadership role

**Organizational Overview**
Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
  
  
The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills - A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
  
  
Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation, Synchrony's Engineering Team is the place to be
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
We are seeking a motivated AVP, Sr Product Engineer, APEX to help design, build, and evolve modern low-code web applications on the Oracle Application Express platform. You will work alongside senior architects and cross-functional agile teams to deliver scalable, secure, and user-friendly solutions that integrate seamlessly with enterprise systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop Oracle APEX applications, including pages, components, dynamic actions, and reports.
* Write efficient PL/SQL, SQL, and database objects (tables, views, packages, triggers) to support application logic and performance.
* Implement custom UI enhancements using JavaScript, jQuery, HTML5, and CSS3 to extend APEX out-of-the-box capabilities.
* Integrate APEX applications with external systems through REST and SOAP web services (both consuming and exposing endpoints via ORDS).
* Collaborate with senior architects on solution design, data modeling, and technical decisions.
* Participate actively in agile/Scrum ceremonies — sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize existing APEX applications for performance, security, and maintainability.
* Apply best practices for application security (authentication, authorization, session state protection, OWASP guidelines).
* Document technical designs, integration specifications, and deployment procedures.
* Support code reviews, testing, and CI/CD-driven deployments across environments

**Qualifications/Requirements**

* 6+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle APEX (version 20.x or higher must).
* 4+ years of experience in Oracle Database, PL/SQL, and SQL (query tuning, analytical functions, packages).
* 4+ years of JavaScript (ES6+) and the APEX JavaScript API.
* Proficiency with CSS3 and responsive design principles; familiarity with Universal Theme customization.
* Mandatory: 4+ years of integrating APEX applications with RESTful and/or SOAP web services, including handling JSON/XML payloads, authentication (OAuth2, Basic, API keys), and error handling.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Familiarity with Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS) for publishing APIs.
* Working experience in agile/Scrum delivery environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills — able to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.

**Eligibility Criteria:**
Minimum 6+Years of experience mentioned in “ Required Skill/Knowledge” with a Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent. In Lieu of degree , minimum of 8 years of experience required.
  
  
**Work Timings: 2 PM – 11 PM IST**
This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs)
  
  
We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR.
  
  
Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events

title: Technical Lead
description:
**About StarRez**
StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user-friendly, all-in-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.
  
  
StarRez operates globally across the USA, UK, Canada, and Australia. The India Center is a pivotal extension of our growth strategy, focusing on building world-class centers of excellence teams while fostering a seamless blend of StarRez's core values with India's dynamic talent ecosystem.
  
  
The Role
  
  
We are looking for a Tech Lead for our Payments Engineering team. Payments is core to how our customers operate, and you will own the architecture and technical direction of the platform that moves real money for institutions around the world. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the technical bar, make the calls on architecture and security, and lead a significant program of work: consolidating a multi generation payments estate onto our modern payment orchestration platform, while keeping every existing integration reliable in production. You will work across a genuinely hybrid technology landscape: a modern cloud-native microservice platform, a large established .NET monolith, and modern React front-ends. If you enjoy raising the standard of a real-world payments system rather than building a greenfield toy, this is that role
  
  
What You Will Own
  
  

* Own the technical vision and architecture for the Payments platform end to end, from PSP integrations through orchestration, tokenization, and settlement flows.
* Lead the consolidation of legacy payment integrations onto our modern Cloud Payment Service (CPS), including the migration of direct debit tokens and recurring payment mandates, which is high-risk, high-value work.
* Drive the design and delivery of new payment service provider (PSP) integrations across a portfolio of 20+ gateways, defining the patterns the rest of the team follows.
* Set and uphold security and compliance standards for a system that handles cardholder and bank data: encryption, secrets management, server-to-server auth, and PCI-aware design.
* Design safe, feature-flagged rollouts and migration paths so changes ship incrementally with clear rollback.
* Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, raise the code-review and testing bar, and grow the technical capability of the team.
* Partner with Product, Engineering Management, and customer-facing teams to sequence delivery and manage the operational risk of live payment changes.
* Stay hands-on: write and review code, pair on the hard problems, and lead by example on quality

What We Work With
  
  

* C# / .NET across two runtimes: a cloud-native platform on .NET 6 and an established .NET Framework 4.8.1 monolith.
* Azure as the primary cloud: Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Service Bus, Front Door, Azure Functions, Application Insights.
* SQL Server with a custom in-house ORM in the monolith.
* React 18 + TypeScript front-ends (payment configuration and management UIs), with GraphQL and modern component tooling.
* Infrastructure as code with Bicep and Terraform; CI/CD on GitHub Actions.
* Feature flags (LaunchDarkly and in-house) for controlled rollout
* PSP / payment gateway integration patterns (iframe-hosted and redirect-based), tokenization, and callback/webhook handling.
* Recurring payments and direct debit / mandate lifecycles.
* Payment security: field-level encryption, JWT server-to-server auth, and OWASP / PCI-aware engineering

**Required Qualifications**
  
  

* Deep experience integrating with third-party payment providers or comparable financial / regulated external APIs.
* Proven experience building and operating production software, with a track record as a technical leader on a complex platform.
* Strong background in distributed systems and service-oriented or microservice architecture, including designing for resilience, idempotency, and eventual consistency.
* Demonstrated ownership of security-sensitive systems and a genuine instinct for handling sensitive data safely.
* Experience leading large migrations or platform consolidations in a live, revenue critical system without disrupting customers.
* Excellent judgement on trade-offs: you know when to modernise, when to leave working code alone, and how to de-risk both.
* A strong quality culture: test-driven development, meaningful code review, and automated verification are how you work, not overhead.
* Clear communicator who can align engineers, product, and stakeholders around a technical direction.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct experience with PCI DSS scope and compliance.
* Experience modernising a .NET Framework monolith toward cloud-native services.
* Familiarity with the Australian, UK, US, or EU payments landscapes and their local gateways.
* Experience with cross-region deployment and data residency requirements.

*Even if you don't have all of the Preferred Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!*
  
  
**Reasons to join our Team:**
  
  
StarRez is not just a workplace—it's a place to belong, build, and grow.
  
  

* A Culture That Lasts: Many of our team members have been with us for 20+ years—a testament to our people-first philosophy.
* Global Impact, Local Ownership: Join a team that spans across Australia, the USA, the UK, and Canada, working on industry-leading solutions, while building the centre up from ground up.
* Long-Term Vision: We're not here for short-term gains. We invest in our people for the long haul, creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and thrive.
* Innovation with Stability: Backed by Vista Equity Partners, we combine the agility of a scaling SaaS company with the stability of long-term industry leadership.
* Z-Factor: We take pride in our culture of passion, care, and high performance. The Z-Factor defines how we support our teams, foster growth, and ensure that everyone at StarRez thrives.

If you are excited about building game-changing products in a high-impact, collaborative environment—StarRez India is the place for you.
  
  
  
  
*We are proud of our diverse workforce and are dedicated to creating a safe and welcoming environment for all employees. People from various ethnicities, ages, genders, and abilities are encouraged to apply.*
  
  
  
  
  
  
***Notice to external Recruiters and Recruitment Agencies:***
  
  
*StarRez will not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, headhunters, or any other third parties for this role through this website or directly to any employee. StarRez and any of our subsidiaries will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company. In addition, we ask that you do not reach out to any employee with regards to this position, or any other positions, now, or in the future.*
  
  
StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Dynamics 365 Engineer
description:
Position Description
  
  
Company Profile:
  
  
At CGI, we’re a team of builders. We call our employees members because all who join CGI are building their own company - one that has grown to 94,000 professionals located in 40 countries. Founded in 1976, CGI is a leading IT and business process services firm committed to helping clients succeed. We have the global resources, expertise, stability and dedicated professionals needed to achieve.
  
  
This is a great opportunity to join a winning team. CGI offers a competitive compensation package with opportunities for growth and professional development. Benefits for full-time, permanent members start on the first day of employment and include a paid time-off program and profit participation and stock purchase plans. We wish to thank all applicants for their interest and effort in applying for this position, however, only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted. No unsolicited agency referrals please.
  
  
Your future duties and responsibilities
  
  
Job Title:MA Dynamics 365
  
  
Position: LA/AC
  
  
Experience: 9 yrs to 12 Yrs
  
  
Category: Software Development
  
  
Main location: Hyderabad.
  
  
Employment Type: Full time
  
  
Dynamics 365 Engineer – UKI SAPDecomEnabler
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
CGI is looking for an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 Engineer supporting the modernisation of enterprise applications and the progressive transition of business capabilities and integrations away from legacy SAP dependent services.
  
  
The Dynamics 365 Engineer will design, build, test and maintain high quality solutions using Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform, working within a cross functional engineering squad alongside Product, Architecture, QA, Operations and other technology teams.
  
  
The role requires strong Dynamics engineering capability together with experience in integrations, APIs, Power Platform, Azure services and modern software engineering practices.
  
  
Within the SAPDecomEnabler context, the engineer will work with relevant application and integration teams to understand existing SAP dependencies and help deliver Dynamics based capabilities and integrations required to support the target state architecture.
  
  
**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Dynamics 365 Engineering
* Design, develop, test and maintain scalable solutions using Microsoft Dynamics 365.
* Configure and customise Dynamics applications to meet agreed business requirements.
* Develop high quality, secure and maintainable solutions in accordance with established engineering standards.
* Develop and maintain Dynamics components including: Entities / tables Plugins Workflows Business logic Web resources Model driven applications Custom controls Integrations
* Analyse technical requirements and translate them into robust Dynamics solutions.
* Ensure solutions meet agreed functional and non functional requirements.
* SAP Decommissioning Enablement
* Work within the UKI SAPDecomEnabler squad to support the transition of relevant capabilities and dependencies away from legacy SAP services.
* Collaborate with SAP, application, architecture and business teams to understand existing process and integration dependencies.
* Identify where Dynamics 365 capabilities form part of the target state solution.
* Develop or enhance Dynamics functionality required to support processes transitioning away from SAP.
* Support the replacement or decoupling of SAP dependent interfaces where Dynamics is part of the target architecture.
* Work with integration teams to ensure downstream and upstream dependencies are understood and addressed.
* Support migration, cutover, validation and stabilisation activities associated with the transition.
* Ensure replacement capabilities are operationally ready before associated legacy dependencies are retired.
* Dynamics 365 & Power Platform
* Develop solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform alongside Dynamics 365.
* Build and enhance solutions using: Power Apps Power Automate Dataverse Model driven applications
* Automate business processes and workflows using appropriate Power Platform capabilities.
* Develop reusable components and patterns where appropriate.
* Ensure Power Platform solutions follow agreed governance, security and development standards.
* Integration Engineering
* Design and develop integrations between Dynamics 365 and other enterprise systems.
* Build and consume REST APIs and web services.
* Support integration with legacy/SAP applications during transition.
* Work with Azure based integration technologies where appropriate.
* Develop solutions using technologies such as: Azure Functions Azure Logic Apps Azure Service Bus APIs / Web Services
* Support event driven and asynchronous integration patterns.
* Ensure integrations are secure, resilient, observable and supportable.
* Troubleshoot complex integration and data flow issues across platforms.
* Software Development

Depending on the Dynamics solution area, develop and maintain solutions using relevant technologies including:
  
  

* C#
* .NET
* JavaScript
* TypeScript
* Dynamics plugins
* Workflow assemblies
* FetchXML
* Web resources
* APIs and web services

Apply appropriate coding standards, design patterns and engineering practices to ensure solutions are maintainable and scalable.
  
  

* CI/CD & DevOps
* Work with modern source control and CI/CD practices.
* Maintain application code and configuration within appropriate version control repositories.
* Build and support automated deployment pipelines for Dynamics and Power Platform solutions.
* Promote controlled and repeatable deployment across environments.
* Participate in code reviews and peer reviews.
* Implement automated testing where appropriate.
* Support continuous improvement of development and deployment practices.
* Ensure releases comply with Centrica change, security and engineering controls.
* Testing & Quality Engineering
* Take ownership of the quality of delivered Dynamics solutions.
* Develop and execute appropriate unit and technical testing.
* Support integration, system and user acceptance testing.
* Participate in peer/code reviews.
* Investigate and resolve defects proactively.
* Ensure technical solutions satisfy functional and non functional requirements.
* Support regression testing during SAP transition and decommissioning activities.
* Validate that changes do not adversely affect existing business processes and integrations.
* Security & Compliance
* Develop solutions in accordance with Centrica security and data protection requirements.
* Apply appropriate Dynamics security roles and access controls.
* Ensure customer and business data is handled responsibly.
* Follow secure software development practices.
* Consider security, privacy and compliance requirements throughout the development lifecycle.
* Work with Security and Architecture teams where design approval or specialist input is required.
* Performance, Resilience & Scalability
* Design Dynamics solutions with appropriate consideration for: Performance Availability Scalability Resilience Maintainability Supportability
* Identify and resolve performance issues.
* Ensure integrations can handle expected business volumes.
* Avoid unnecessary customisation where standard Dynamics/Power Platform capabilities can meet requirements effectively.
* Contribute to continuous platform optimisation.
* Live Service Support
* Support Dynamics solutions after deployment into production.
* Participate in incident investigation and technical troubleshooting.
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues.
* Resolve defects and production problems.
* Contribute to ongoing platform and service improvements.
* Ensure appropriate technical documentation and support knowledge is maintained.
* Support hypercare following major migrations or SAP decommissioning releases.
* Agile & Cross Functional Delivery
* Work as part of the UKI SAPDecomEnabler cross functional squad.
* Collaborate closely with: Product Owners Software Engineers SAP SMEs Solution/Technical Architects QA / Quality Engineering Security Infrastructure Integration teams Operations Business stakeholders
* Participate in sprint planning, refinement, stand ups, retrospectives and technical design discussions.
* Take ownership of agreed work items through to completion.
* Raise risks, blockers and dependencies early.
* Contribute positively to team delivery and continuous improvement.

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  
The successful candidate should have strong hands on experience in:
  
  

* Microsoft Dynamics 365
* Dynamics 365 configuration and customisation
* C# / .NET
* JavaScript and/or TypeScript
* Dynamics plugins and workflows
* Power Apps
* Power Automate
* Dataverse
* REST APIs / Web APIs / Web Services
* Enterprise system integration
* Source control and CI/CD
* Automated testing and code review
* Secure software engineering practices

The candidate should also demonstrate:
  
  

* Experience working as a software engineer within a modern cross functional Agile/product squad.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Understanding of non functional requirements including performance, resilience and scalability.
* Experience supporting live enterprise applications.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem solving capability.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.

Desirable Technical Skills
  
  
Experience in the following would be advantageous:
  
  

* Azure Functions
* Azure Logic Apps
* Azure Service Bus
* Azure DevOps
* Event driven architectures
* Asynchronous processing
* PCF Controls
* FetchXML
* Workflow Assemblies
* Dynamics Web Resources
* Power Platform governance
* Application monitoring and observability
* Cloud native integration patterns

SAP Transformation Experience – Highly Desirable
  
  
For the UKI SAPDecomEnabler squad, candidates with the following experience would be particularly valuable:
  
  

* Previous involvement in SAP transformation, migration or decommissioning programmes.
* Experience replacing business capabilities previously delivered through SAP.
* Experience decoupling enterprise applications from SAP integrations.
* Understanding of SAP to Dynamics integration patterns.
* Experience with enterprise data migration and interface transition.
* Experience identifying upstream/downstream system dependencies.
* Experience supporting technical cutover and hypercare.
* Understanding of controlled legacy system retirement.

Deep SAP development expertise is not necessarily required; the primary requirement is Dynamics engineering capability combined with the ability to work effectively with SAP and integration teams during the transition.
  
  
Dynamics Product Experience
  
  
Depending on the specific capability being transitioned, relevant experience may include one or more of:
  
  

* Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE)
* Dynamics 365 Customer Service
* Dynamics 365 Field Service
* Dynamics 365 Sales
* Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O)
* Power Platform / Dataverse

Candidates do not necessarily need deep expertise across every Dynamics product. The appropriate Dynamics specialisation should align with the specific business capability being transitioned by the squad.
  
  
Certifications – Desirable
  
  
Relevant Microsoft certifications would be advantageous, including:
  
  

* Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Developer
* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer
* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant certifications
* Relevant Azure certifications

Key Competencies
  
  
Dynamics EngineeringStrong hands on capability to configure, customise, develop and support enterprise grade Dynamics solutions.
  
  
Integration Thinking: Understands how Dynamics interacts with APIs, Azure services, legacy platforms and other enterprise applications.
  
  
Problem Solving Able to investigate complex application and integration issues and identify practical technical solutions.
  
  
Engineering Quality: Produces secure, maintainable and well-tested code and takes ownership of quality throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
Collaboration: Works effectively with Product, Architecture, SAP, QA, Security, Operations and other engineering teams.
  
  
Ownership: Takes responsibility for agreed deliverables, proactively identifies risks and follows issues through to resolution.
  
  
Continuous Improvement Actively improves engineering practices, automation, maintainability and platform capability.
  
  
Expected Outcomes
  
  
The Dynamics 365 Engineer will help the UKI SAPDecomEnabler squad to:
  
  

* Deliver Dynamics capabilities required by the target state architecture.
* Reduce business process and application dependencies on legacy SAP services.
* Build secure and scalable Dynamics solutions.
* Establish robust integrations between Dynamics and strategic enterprise platforms.
* Automate business processes using Dynamics and Power Platform.
* Improve maintainability through modern software engineering and DevOps practices.
* Ensure replacement services are production ready before legacy dependencies are retired.
* Support safe migration, cutover and stabilisation.
* Contribute to Centrica's wider technology modernisation objectives.

Candidate Profile
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands on Dynamics engineer rather than purely a Dynamics functional consultant.
  
  
They should be comfortable working across Dynamics configuration, custom development, Power Platform and enterprise integrations, while collaborating with architects, SAP teams and business stakeholders.
  
  
For this particular squad, the strongest candidate would combine:
  
  
Dynamics 365 + C#/.NET + Power Platform + APIs/Integration + Azure + modern engineering practices
  
  
with previous exposure to SAP transformation/decommissioning or complex legacy modernisation programmes.
  
  
Candidates with backgrounds such as Dynamics 365 Developer, Dynamics Engineer, CRM Developer, Power Platform/Dynamics Developer or Full Stack D365 Engineer would be particularly relevant.
  
  
**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
  
  
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
  
  
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
  
  
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  
  
That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.
  
  
Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

title: Android App Development Intern
description:
**Company Description**
Weskill is an online training platform focused on upskilling undergraduate students through practical, hands-on learning. The organization is dedicated to closing the gap between academic coursework and real-world corporate expectations. Its programs are designed to equip learners with job-ready skills that align with current industry needs. Graduates of Weskill are prepared to pursue opportunities at high-growth startups and leading multinational companies, supporting a strong foundation for their future careers.
  
**Role Description**
The Android App Development Intern role at Weskill is a remote internship focused on supporting the design, development, and maintenance of Android applications. Interns will assist in writing clean and efficient code, implementing new features, fixing bugs, and optimizing app performance under the guidance of senior developers. Daily tasks may include collaborating with team members, participating in code reviews, testing applications, documenting work, and contributing to improvements in user experience. The role also involves learning best practices in mobile development and aligning project work with Weskill’s training and educational objectives.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills, including problem-solving and the ability to debug and optimize code.
* Candidates should possess solid Communication skills for effective collaboration, documentation, and interaction with mentors and team members.
* Candidates should possess foundational Software Development and Programming skills, preferably in Java or Kotlin, and familiarity with Android SDK and related tools.
* Candidates should possess basic Sales or product-awareness skills, such as understanding user needs and contributing ideas to improve app adoption and engagement.
* Additional beneficial qualifications include familiarity with version control (e.g., Git), knowledge of RESTful APIs, eagerness to learn, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.
* Enrollment in or completion of a degree program in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory, provided equivalent skills and experience can be demonstrated.

title: Engineering Manager - Software
description:
**Quin | About the Company**
Quin is a safety-technology company. Our technology ships inside products from leading global brands across motorcycling, cycling, sport and industrial PPE. We are becoming the primary source of real-world crash data across every protective gear category, and we build the data tools that manufacturers and testing bodies use to engineer safer products and standards. Our engineering and product centre is in Hyderabad, with helmet testing labs in Hyderabad and London, and teams across India, the UK and the US.
  
  
**Why this role exists**
Our software team builds the apps, cloud services and web tools that turn sensor data from a helmet into a crash alert, a simple NFC tag into a data operations platform for global brands and more. The team has shipped a lot, fast. We are looking to strengthen this team with a leader who will make it consistently excellent: stronger engineers, higher standards and processes that deliver outcomes end to end.
  
  
You will lead the people and the work. You will hire, grow and hold the bar for every software engineer at Quin, and stay hands-on and close to the code.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**People and performance**

* Lead the software team day to day
* Grow engineers.
* Build a culture where everyone owns their work from start to finish, where problem-solving is an obsession, and people and achievements are celebrated.

**Hiring**

* Own software hiring with senior leadership: plan the roles, run the technical assessments and make the call.
* Raise the bar with every hire.

**Engineering quality**

* Set and enforce standards for code review, testing, CI/CD and documentation across mobile, backend and web.
* Improve quality aggressively. Move the team from manual testing at the end towards automated testing built in from the start.
* Remove single points of failure. Every critical system has a second owner and documentation that someone else can use.

**Hands-on engineering**

* Review code and designs every week. Know the codebase well enough to spot risk early.
* Step in on hard problems: debug a production issue, unblock a stuck feature, or pair with an engineer on a tricky design.

**Working across Quin**

* Work with the TPM on realistic estimates and capacity, so delivery dates are consistently hit.
* Work with Product and Design on requirements, playing a key role on what & why, not just how.
* Work with the Embedded / Platform Lead where app and cloud meet firmware and BLE.

**Who You Are**

* You're a builder of people.
* You have grit.
* You're optimistic and honest.
* You know and can communicate the why.
* You're still an engineer. (eg You review code every week and would rather work on a hard bug than write a status report.)
* You're present. (eg You lead from the floor in Hyderabad, and your team always knows where to find you.)

**This role isn't for you if**
you want to stop being hands-on, you measure success by headcount, or you need a settled, process-heavy environment to do your best work.
  
  
**Must-haves**

* 7+ years in software engineering, with 3+ years managing engineers directly in a product company.
* Strong hands-on background in at least one of: mobile (iOS or Android), backend/cloud, or web. Working knowledge of the others.
* A track record of growing engineers, with people you can name who moved up under your leadership.
* Experience introducing engineering standards from an early stage: code review, automated testing, CI/CD and documentation.
* Hiring experience: you have designed technical assessments and built a team.
* Clear, direct written and spoken communication skills without depending on AI polish. You can explain a technical decision to an engineer, a product manager and/or a client.
* You use AI tools heavily in your own work and know how to make a team faster with them, but you could do the job without it.

**Strong pluses**

* Apps that work with connected hardware: BLE, IoT, wearables or automotive.
* Real-time or safety-critical systems, where a missed event matters.
* Data-heavy products: streaming sensor data, analytics or ML pipelines.
* Moving a team from manual QA to automated testing.
* Platforms serving enterprise customers with security and compliance needs (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR).

**How We Work**
We are a small team of senior doers who move fast with excellence. Our managers lead by example, not by layers. You will have real ownership of your team and its standards, with very little bureaucracy, and we expect you to use it.
  
  
**Our hiring process & AI use**
Use AI tools freely on any exercise. The only rule: declare what you used and be ready to defend every decision live. The recruitment process will involve at least 2 interviews and 1 assignment with live debrief.

title: Intermediate Quality Engineer [T500-29916]
description:
**About CIBC:**

CIBC is a leading North American bank, with a history of more than 150 years of living our purpose - to help make your ambition a reality. Client relationships are at the center of our strategy, and our growth is enabled by a highly engaged and connected global team. From digital banking to community impact, we’re proud to drive progress for our clients and our communities. Recognized for our culture, award-winning innovation and community investment, CIBC continues to evolve by putting people and progress at the centre of everything we do.

**About CIBC India:**

CIBC India is a technology and operations hub in Hyderabad, where you’ll be part of our highly engaged and global team, and play a central role in supporting our growth. Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.

**What CIBC India Offers:**

At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance-based incentive programs, a family-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide

We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

**What You’ll Be Doing (position summary):**

The Intermediate Quality Engineer is responsible for leading and coordinating all aspects of quality engineering and software testing for assigned projects or initiatives. This role ensures rigorous adherence to QA/QE standards, manages testing teams, and drives the implementation of automation and innovative solutions to improve quality, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness. The incumbent adds value by providing technical leadership, ensuring compliance, and supporting continuous improvement in testing processes and methodologies.

At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.

**How You’ll Succeed (responsibilities):**

* Develop, publish, and execute test plans, test cases, traceability matrices, automation scripts, virtualization, status reports, defect and exit reports.
* Identify and obtain required test data and test environments.
* Develop, publish, and execute testing estimates and manage financials related to testing activities.
* Track and report QA/QE metrics and KPIs such as velocity and defect slippage.

**Defect & Compliance Management**

* Manage defects throughout their lifecycle, ensuring timely resolution and documentation.
* Identify, manage, and implement remediation for any noncompliance items and deviations.
* Ensure adherence to QA/QE standards and support the implementation of new standards.
* Recognize and identify areas for process, policy, or tool improvement.

**Technical Leadership:**

* Provide input, feedback, and challenge to technical designs and assess impacts to testing.
* Identify and implement automation, AI, or other emerging solutions to expedite testing and improve quality.
* Lead the adoption of automation frameworks and tools.

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:**

* Collaborates with project managers, business analysts, developers, and other stakeholders to coordinate testing activities and ensure alignment with project objectives.
* Works closely with development teams to provide feedback on technical designs and assess testing impacts.
* Interacts with external vendors and tool providers to evaluate and integrate testing solutions.
* Partners with other QA/QE professionals across the organization to share best practices and drive continuous improvement.
* As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines, and controls.
* As a key contributor to the business unit, this job has the authority to recommend changes to business processes in order to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.

**JOB DIMENSIONS:**

* Responsible for the delivery of testing services for assigned projects/initiatives, supporting retail banking, mobile, web-based, UX, API, and accessibility testing.
* Provides technical and process leadership to ensure quality standards are met.
* Supports achievement of business unit goals through effective quality engineering and testing practices.

**Experience:**
3-5 years of experience

**Who You Are (skills/qualifications):**

**Must Have Skills:**

* **Strong hands-on experience in AEM testing, Playwright, Python/Java**
* 3–5 years of experience in native Mobile QA/QE, 1–3 years of experience in development.
* iOS/Android Mobile QA expertise
* Programming languages commonly used for automation (any of Python, Java, JavaScript)
* Automation frameworks, tools, and libraries (Robot framework, Appium (native mobile testing), and any of, Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, Junit, etc.)
* Writing and executing automation test cases, custom functions, and building object repositories
* Cloud-based device testing (e.g., HPMC, Perfector or similar other tools)
* Web technologies (HTML, CSS, web services) and Version control systems (e.g. GIT)
* ***Accessibility Testing Skills for Mobile Devices:***
  *Strong knowledge of WCAG 2.1 standards and assistive technologies.*
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities (
  *Ability to analyze data accuracy in Adobe Analytics report)*
  .
* Quality management and assurance expertise.

**Good to Have:**

* Basic knowledge of databases and SQL queries.
* Regulatory compliance testing experience
* API testing, virtualization, Appium
* GitHub Copilot or other Gen AI-based tools. Jira, Confluence, and/or other Agile, development, and QA tools.
* Parasoft, Rest API, and/or other API testing and virtualization tools.
* Perfecto and/or other mobile and browser testing tools.
* CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions)

**Privacy:**

By proceeding with the creation of a profile and submitting an application in response to this job posting, you acknowledge and agree that your personal data will be collected, used, retained and disclosed by CIBC India and its affiliates, as described in the Candidate Privacy Statement.

title: Sr QA Engineer - Espresso, Kotlin, Roborazzi, JUnit, Git Actions & Android
description:
**Scope**

* Contribute as a QA engineer for supply chain SaaS products with a particular focus on store-based kiosk dropoffs for returned retail goods. Support best practices across automation, test planning, execution, metrics, and release readiness.
* Develop, maintain, and improve automation frameworks and test suites for Returns workflows, APIs, integrations, and critical customer-facing capabilities.
* Work with other product development teams to improve test coverage for returns initiation, tracking, notifications, disposition decisions, inventory visibility, warehouse returns processing, and related reverse logistics workflows.
* Partner with Product Management, Platform Engineering, UX, Cloud Operations, Support, and implementation teams to help deliver high-quality software aligned to roadmap commitments and customer outcomes.

**Our Current Technical Environment**

* Software: Kotlin, Android, MongoDB, Amplitude, Sentry
* Hardware: Custom Android-based kiosks, scanners, printers, and sensors with proprietary SDKs.
* Automation Framework: Espresso, JUnit, Selenium WebDriver, Robolectric
* DevOps: AWS, Azure, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Sauce Labs, Firebase, JFrog, Postman
* Architecture: Scalable, resilient, service-oriented architecture, distributed, asynchronous, offline-first, high availability.

**What You’ll Do**

* Apply QA automation and performance testing practices; provide input on options and recommendations as needed.
* Develop, maintain, and improve automation frameworks, reusable scripts, and test suites.
* Determine test scenario priorities, create execution plans, and support coverage for critical features.
* Create clear, comprehensive test plans, test procedures, test cases, and automation documentation.
* Estimate, prioritize, plan, and coordinate testing activities across functional, regression, API, database, performance, PSR, and security testing.
* Design, develop, execute, and analyze automated tests using open-source tools and CI/CD best practices.
* Identify, document, track, and help resolve defects; perform regression testing when issues are fixed.
* Partner with developers, product managers, UX, and cloud teams to clarify requirements, improve product quality, and support release readiness.
* Investigate causes of non-conforming software, monitor debugging results, and recommend practical solutions.
* Track QA metrics such as automation progress, defect density, open defects, execution results, and release readiness.
* Share knowledge with QA engineers on automation frameworks, testing standards, tools, and best practices.
* Stay current with new testing tools, libraries, and test strategies.

**What We Are Looking For**

* BE/B.Tech, ME/M.Tech, MCA, or related degree with 5–8 years of experience in QA automation, software development, or quality assurance for large enterprise applications.
* Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools, processes, and Agile/Scrum development practices.
* Hands-on experience developing and maintaining automation frameworks such as Espresso, Kotlin, Roborazzi, JUnit, Git Actions & Android
* Knowledge of modern web development practices, OOP concepts, git, and branching strategies.
* Prior experience testing and introspecting Android devices in a live runtime environment using remote debugging tools.
* Familiarity with accessibility standards and testing best practices.
* Experience testing web applications, RESTful services, APIs, databases, and complex enterprise workflows.
* Solid SQL skills and experience with Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar relational databases.
* Experience with test management, defect tracking, reporting, and CI/CD tools such as Jira, Spira, Zephyr, Xray, Allure, Jenkins, Postman, or similar tools.
* Hands-on experience with white box, black box, functional, regression, automation, performance, and security testing.
* Experience working with white-label products and complex configuration environments.
* Ability to install and configure relevant products, troubleshoot issues, and provide practical inputs to development teams.
* Supply chain domain knowledge; returns, warehouse, inventory, logistics, commerce, or reverse logistics experience preferred.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and continuous improvement skills.

**Our Values**
If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.
