title: Senior CV Engineer
description:
Job Description

Role: AI / Computer Vision Engineer – Flight Turnaround Monitoring System

Key Responsibilities

• Model development: Design, train and optimise deep learning models for object detection, multi-object tracking, segmentation and video-based activity recognition on airport apron footage. • Activity-detection pipeline: Build the end-to-end pipeline that converts detections and tracks into turnaround events – combining detectors, trackers, stand-zone (ROI) geometry, temporal action models and a rule/state-machine layer with robust start/end timestamping.

• Accuracy ownership: Define the evaluation protocol with the product team, build and maintain a golden test set, and drive per-activity precision, recall and timestamp accuracy to the agreed targets.

• Dataset engineering: Own the data strategy – camera-view coverage, annotation guidelines and QA, active learning, hard-negative mining, class-imbalance handling and synthetic/augmented data for rare or safety-critical events.

• Robustness: Make models reliable across night, rain, fog, glare, shadows, heavy occlusion by aircraft and vehicles, small/distant objects, differing camera angles and different airports or stands. • Error analysis: Run systematic failure analysis (by activity, camera, time of day and weather) and convert findings into data, model or logic improvements in fast iteration cycles.

• Production inference: Optimise multi-stream, low-latency inference with GPU acceleration (TensorRT / ONNX Runtime / DeepStream) on data-centre or edge hardware.

• MLOps: Set up experiment tracking, dataset and model versioning, automated evaluation, shadow-mode validation, drift monitoring and a retraining loop with human-in-the-loop correction.

• Integration: Work with backend, product and operations teams to publish activity events via Redis / RabbitMQ / SQL to dashboards, alerts and turnaround-time (TAT) analytics.

• Leadership: Mentor junior engineers, contribute to architecture decisions, technical reviews and roadmap planning, and track emerging research in video understanding and edge AI. Accuracy & Performance Expectations Targets below are indicative and will be finalised per activity during the pilot. The engineer is expected to define how they are measured and to reach them in production conditions, not only on a held-out dataset.

• Event-level detection: Target ≥ 95% precision and ≥ 90–95% recall per activity (event level F1), measured against a manually annotated golden set; safety-critical activities (e.g. refuelling, chocks, pushback) held to the higher bar.

• Timestamp accuracy: Start/end times of activities within an agreed tolerance (e.g. ± 5–10 seconds) of ground truth; reported using temporal IoU and mean absolute timestamp error.

• Object detection / tracking: Strong mAP on apron object classes (aircraft, GSE, personnel, doors, cones, chocks, hoses) with stable track IDs through occlusion (high IDF1 / low ID-switch rate).

• Robustness: Performance reported per slice (day/night, weather, camera, stand) with no slice falling materially below the overall target.

• Operational: Real-time processing across all configured camera streams per GPU, with a false-alarm rate that operations teams can act on.

Required Skills and Qualifications Core computer vision and deep learning

• Expert-level Python with strong software engineering practices (testing, packaging, code review). • Strong foundation in machine learning, neural networks and image/video processing.

• Extensive hands-on experience with PyTorch for training, fine-tuning and deploying models.

• Proficiency in OpenCV and video I/O (FFmpeg, GStreamer, RTSP/H.264/H.265 streams).

• Practical experience with modern detectors and segmenters (YOLO family, RT-DETR / DETR, Faster R-CNN, Mask R-CNN, U-Net) including fine-tuning on custom datasets. Video understanding and activity recognition (critical for this role)

• Multi-object tracking: ByteTrack, BoT-SORT, DeepSORT or similar, including re identification and handling of long occlusions.

• Action recognition / temporal action detection: SlowFast, X3D, TSM, TimeSformer, VideoMAE, Video Swin or similar; experience with temporal modelling (LSTM / GRU / Transformers / temporal convolution) on top of frame-level features.

• Spatio-temporal reasoning: zone/ROI-based logic, object–object and object–person interaction (e.g. vehicle docked at aircraft door, hose connected), and rule or state-machine event engines.

• Pose estimation and small-object detection techniques (tiling / SAHI, high-resolution inference, multi-scale features). Data, training and accuracy engineering

• Building annotation pipelines with CVAT / Label Studio or similar; writing labelling guidelines and running inter-annotator QA.

• Handling class imbalance and rare events: hard-negative mining, active learning, focal / weighted losses, targeted augmentation, semi-/self-supervised learning and synthetic data.

• Rigorous evaluation: mAP, precision/recall/F1, confusion matrices, temporal IoU, IDF1/MOTA, threshold and confidence calibration, and sliced analysis by lighting, weather and camera view.

• Robustness to domain shift: day/night, rain, fog, glare, camera placement and cross-site generalisation; low-light enhancement and, where applicable, thermal/IR imagery.

• Experiment tracking and reproducibility: MLflow or Weights & Biases, DVC or equivalent for dataset/model versioning. Deployment and integration

• Real-time inference optimisation with ONNX Runtime and TensorRT (FP16/INT8 quantisation, batching); NVIDIA DeepStream or Triton Inference Server is a strong plus.

• Experience running multi-stream video analytics on GPU servers and/or edge devices (e.g. NVIDIA Jetson).

• Proficiency in Docker and CUDA for containerised, GPU-accelerated deployment.

• Experience integrating with Redis, RabbitMQ (or Kafka) and SQL databases for event streaming and storage.

• Strong command of Linux, including scripting, debugging and performance profiling. Experience and soft skills

• 2+ years in applied computer vision, with at least 2 years delivering video-based detection or activity-recognition systems to production.

• Proven record of taking a model from a prototype to meeting a measured accuracy target in real-world conditions.

• Ability to solve complex problems independently, lead technical initiatives and mentor others.

• Clear communication for cross-functional collaboration and technical documentation. Good to Have

• Prior work in aviation, airport operations, logistics, industrial safety or other CCTV-based activity monitoring.

• Experience with vision-language / foundation models (e.g. CLIP, SAM, Grounding DINO, VLMs) for auto-labelling or open-vocabulary detection.

• Knowledge of A-CDM / turnaround milestone standards and airport ground-handling processes. • Experience with multi-camera calibration, camera-to-stand mapping, and model compression (pruning, distillation).

• Publications or open-source contributions in video understanding or object tracking.

description:
**The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership**
With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we’re elevating the standards for an entire industry – and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership.
  
  
At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Backend Development**

* Design and develop scalable backend services, REST APIs, business logic, data-access components and integration modules.
* Develop and maintain enterprise applications using C#, ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET Zero, ABP.io and SQL Server.
* Contribute to ASP.NET Zero-to-ABP.io modernization and migration activities.
* Apply object-oriented design, modular architecture, design patterns, and clean coding practices.

**Messaging and Real-Time Integration**

* Design RabbitMQ-based asynchronous messaging, event-driven workflows, and distributed processing mechanisms.
* Develop SignalR-based services for alarms, notifications, events, status updates, and operational monitoring.
* Optimize message delivery, event processing, resiliency, fault handling, and system responsiveness.

**Platform and Infrastructure Services**

* Deploy, configure, and support ASP.NET applications and backend services hosted on IIS.
* Manage security settings, certificates, performance tuning, logging, monitoring, diagnostics, and recovery.
* Support CI/CD pipelines, automated builds, release management, and production deployments.
* Troubleshoot application, server, network, database, and deployment issues.

**Device and Protocol Integration**

* Develop and maintain C++ services, native libraries, communication modules, and protocol-handling components.
* Use Boost for networking, threading, asynchronous processing, messaging, and system-level operations.
* Integrate controllers, panels, security devices, cameras, and field hardware.
* Resolve protocol, communication, synchronization, performance, and stability issues.

**Video and Streaming Services**

* Integrate video-management and surveillance systems using RTSP-based streams.
* Develop and support WebRTC services for secure, low-latency browser video delivery.
* Support video monitoring, event correlation, alarm verification, and associated-camera workflows.
* Troubleshoot stream connectivity, conversion, latency, and browser-delivery issues.

**Application Support and Collaboration**

* Monitor system health, availability, performance, reliability, and scalability; maintain logging, auditing, tracing, and alerts.
* Apply secure coding practices and protect credentials, certificates, tokens, keys, and configuration secrets.
* Perform root-cause analysis and drive corrective actions, technical-debt reduction, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Architecture, QA, DevOps, UI/UX, and global engineering teams.
* Participate in design reviews, code reviews, technical planning, testing, releases, and documentation.

**Required Skills**
**Core Backend Development**

* 8-12 years of software development experience.
* Strong experience in C#, ASP.NET Core, and REST API development.
* Experience with ASP.NET Zero and/or ABP.io.
* Good knowledge of SQL Server and Entity Framework Core.
* Strong understanding of software design principles and clean coding practices.

**Messaging & Platform Technologies**

* Experience with RabbitMQ or similar messaging platforms.
* Experience with SignalR, WebSockets, or real-time communication technologies.
* Strong experience in C++ development.
* Experience using Boost libraries.
* Understanding of TCP/IP, networking, multithreading, and asynchronous programming.

**Infrastructure & Engineering Practices**

* Experience deploying and supporting applications on IIS.
* Experience with Git, Bitbucket, SVN, and Jira.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, automated testing, and code quality practices.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience migrating applications from ASP.NET Zero to ABP.io.
* Experience with RTSP and WebRTC technologies.
* Experience integrating controllers, alarm panels, cameras and field devices.
* Exposure to Angular and TypeScript.
* Knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and secure API design.
* Experience with Windows Services and distributed systems.
* Experience in access control, intrusion, video surveillance, or physical security platforms.

**Education**
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, electronics engineering, or a related discipline.
  
  
**World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety**
Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. title: Design System/UX Engineer
description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.
  
  
TTEC Digital seeks a Design System/UX Engineer to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!
  
  
**The work:**
We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that’s been obsessed with customer experience since 1982.
  
  
This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don’t just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds.
  
  
**Who we hire — the DNA:**

* Self-starters and do-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals.
* Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama.
* Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread.
* AI-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.
* Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.
* Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them.
* You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we.
* No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

**What You Will Do:**
**The role:**

* Own the design system in code and the UX of the wedge — the Agent UI shell, slide-out / pill, Control UI, and the per-module panels
* UX here ships as code, not Figma hand-offs. This is not a look-pretty job: the UI renders live voice, desktop, and AI event streams in real time, and you have to understand the technology underneath — events, WebSocket state, latency, plugin loading — so what you design flows and works, not just looks good
* Startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast, move forward.

**What you'll own:**

* The design system as a real component library — templates and patterns developers implement without friction
* Agent UI / Control UI interaction patterns
* Active Listening and Agent Handover UX
* The graphics language of the product (iconography, motion, data visualization)
* Accessibility (Lighthouse a11y > 90) and keyboard-first agent flows
* Your committed timelines.

**Who you are:**

* A self-starter with taste and grit — a designer who ships
* Show-me mentality: you demo working UI on Fridays like every other engineer
* You think from the developer's seat: every component you design, you've already thought through how the squads will implement, extend, and theme it — your design system makes them faster, never slower
* You love new technology, adapt fast when the product shifts weekly, use AI tools daily to multiply velocity, consider yourself exceptional, and like winning.

**What You Will Bring:**

* 7+ years of product design with real front-end engineering — you ship React + TypeScript, not just specs.
* Strong graphics experience — ++++ on visual craft: iconography, motion design, canvas/SVG data visualization, rendering dense live data beautifully and legibly.
* Has owned a design system as a living component library in a fast-shipping product — versioned, documented, themed, adopted.
* Strong templating discipline — reusable patterns and layout systems built for developer implementation; you understand component APIs, composition, and what makes a pattern cheap or expensive to build.
* Understands the tech underneath — WebSocket-driven state, event ordering, render performance, module federation/plugin loading — well enough that your designs never fight the architecture.
* Strong on dense, real-time, professional-tool UX (think trading terminals, not marketing sites) — an agent lives in this UI 8 hours a day.
* Accessibility and keyboard-first design as defaults, not afterthoughts.
* Perceived-performance craft — skeletons, optimistic updates, motion that masks latency; the UI must feel instant even when the network isn't.
* Design tokens as the theming backbone — enterprise customers will want branding; tokens make that config, not a rewrite.
* Overlay/extension constraints fluency — designing UI injected over a host page (pill, slide-out) with its size, z-index, and isolation realities.
* Usability evidence at startup speed — lightweight session recordings and agent feedback loops instead of month-long studies.
* A debugger in the browser — you profile the render, find the jank, and fix your own component.

**Job Title: Engineer III, TEM Semiconductor**
**Location/Division Specific Information**
Hyderabad, IN - Analytical Instruments Group, Materials & Structural Analysis Division
  
  
**About the product: The Thermo Scientific™ Metrios™ is an advanced TEM imaging system designed to automate and optimize imaging workflows. With the Metrios™ AX, we introduced the world's first commercially available Scanning Transmission Electron Microscope (S/TEM) using machine learning for automated, high-quality data collection. Exclusively designed for the semiconductor industry, the Metrios series removes automation barriers, enabling labs to measure critical dimensions of semiconductor devices during development and manufacturing.**
**How will you make an impact?**
We're seeking a Full Stack Software Engineer to join our TEM Semiconductor value stream, focused on innovative S/TEM solutions tailored for semiconductor metrology workflows. As a member of a distributed agile Scrum team, you will collaborate closely with teams in the Netherlands and Czech Republic. You will primarily build desktop applications and high-performance software using C# and Python, with front-end development in WPF or TypeScript. Your work will enable the acquisition, processing, and visualization of advanced microscopy datasets.
  
  
**What will you do?**
You will be part of the TEM organization within Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Materials and Structural Analysis R&D organization, which is committed to bringing game-changing solutions to our customers to help them achieve success.
  
  
You will be based in Hyderabad, IN, and report to the Functional Group Lead.
  
  
In this role, you'll collaborate with developers, product owners, architects, and other stakeholders, uniting multi-site teams to deliver reliable and secure software solutions. Your responsibilities include:
  
  

* Design and implement robust, secure, and efficient back-end services and REST APIs using C#, Python, and ASP.NET.
* Develop user-friendly front-end interfaces and components using WPF and/or TypeScript to enhance the user experience.
* Participate in code reviews, ensuring code quality and adherence to coding standards.
* Diagnose and resolve software defects to maintain optimal performance.
* Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies to continuously improve software development practices.
* Leverage AI tools and technologies to improve developer productivity and accelerate delivery of high-quality software solutions.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams to deploy and maintain applications efficiently.
* Contribute to documentation of software designs, architecture, and development processes.
* Promote and drive adoption of good software development practices in code and infrastructure health, quality, test stability, and maintainability.
* Mentor and learn from other developers.
* Regularly reflect on how to help the team be more effective.
* Learn TEM and SEMI domain-specific knowledge and test software solutions on a TEM.

**How will you get here?**
The ideal candidate for this position enjoys working in a multi-disciplinary and multi-cultural environment to address software challenges. If you enjoy the development of software solutions on top of high-performance systems, this is an excellent opportunity. The successful candidate will possess the following combination of education and experience:
  
  
**Education:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, with expertise in software development.

**Experience:**

* 5+ years of Proven experience as a Full Stack Software Engineer with a strong focus on .NET technologies.
* Proficiency in front-end development using WPF, TypeScript, and HTML/CSS.
* Experience with microservices design, implementation, and deployment in a containerized environment and a container orchestration platform such as Kubernetes.
* Exceptional problem-solving skills and a history of resolving complex technical challenges.
* Experience with AI/ML, including deep convolutional neural networks, image processing, or related areas, is nice to have.
* Experience applying AI tools in day-to-day software development to enhance productivity, quality, and delivery speed.
* Self-motivation and the ability to excel independently in a fast-paced setting.

description:

The Junior RPA, Automation & AI Analyst is an entry-level role supporting the delivery of process automation and operational efficiency initiatives within the ERP Tech Factory. * Lead requirements workshops, process discovery sessions, and solution discussions with business and technology stakeholders.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, solution requirements, and system design inputs.
* Drive requirements analysis, gap assessment, configuration advisory, and solution mapping across Finacle and surrounding banking applications.

* Coordinate across Business, Technology, Development, Testing, Infrastructure, Data Migration and Vendor teams.

**Description**
 The Amazon Travel \& Events (AT\&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi\-year transformation of the end\-to\-end Travel \& Expense experience for over 500,000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI\-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context\-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale.
   

  

 We are seeking a passionate Software Development Engineer who can help us build the next generation of unified Travel \& Expense systems and support the AT\&E organization.
   

  

 As a Software Development Engineer on the team, you will design and build services that power AI\-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking experiences, automated expense workflows, centralized payment mechanisms, and real\-time T\&E analytics serving a global customer base. You will collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and senior and peer\-level software engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations including Accounts Payable and Global Corporate Procurement. This role provides you with autonomy and ownership over decisions, working backwards directly from customers. There is ample opportunity for growth due to the high\-visibility work and presence of senior engineering talent for guidance and mentorship. The team operates in cross\-functional two\-pizza team structures that lead T\&E technical transformations.
   

  

 You will contribute to a three\-tier AI architecture that answers employee policy questions in under 2 seconds with source references, and proactively surfaces policy\-compliant recommendations during booking to prevent violations before they occur. You will build modern, mobile\-first travel booking and Meetings \& Events hub experiences across 45\+ countries with real\-time validation and calendar integration. You will develop guided workflows, automated data integration pipelines, and conversational agents that significantly reduce expense report submission time and eliminate a meaningful share of expense reports entirely. You will build virtual payment capabilities and central card automation that reduce out\-of\-pocket employee spend and target zero manual reconciliation. You will develop AI/ML\-powered fraud detection models that automate the majority of investigation checks and support transaction\-based detection across expanding payment avenues. You will build a single\-source T\&E analytics platform providing real\-time spend insights, policy violation tracking, and cost optimization visibility for managers and finance partners.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design and implement scalable service architectures that power AI\-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking, and automated expense workflows for a global user base.
* Deliver working features across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations.
* Collaborate with product managers, applied scientists, and engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations to translate business needs into reliable technical solutions.
* Coach teammates through code reviews and design discussions, raising the quality bar for the team's software and establishing shared engineering best practices.

 The Amazon Travel and Events Tech team sits within Finance Automation and is on a multi\-year mission to unify how Amazon employees plan, book, pay for, and expense business travel and events worldwide. description:
**Salesforce Senior Developer**
**Who We Are: (** 
**www.credera.com** 
**)**
 Credera, trading as TA Digital, is a global consulting firm that combines transformational consulting capabilities, deep industry knowledge, and AI and technology expertise to deliver valuable customer experience and accelerated growth across a broad range of industries worldwide. Our one\-of\-a\-kind global boutique approach means we provide our clients with tailored solutions unique to their organization that can scale due to our extensive footprint. As a values\-led organization, our mission is to make an extraordinary impact on our clients, our people, and our community. We believe it is this approach that has allowed us to work with and transform the most influential brands and organizations in the world, from strategy through to execution.
   

  

 More information is available at www.credera.com. We are part of the OPMG Group of Companies, a division of Omnicom Group Inc.
   

  

**About the Role:**
 We are hiring a hands\-on Salesforce Senior Developer, based in India, to build Salesforce Core Platform and Experience Cloud solutions for our clients, with a strong focus on the nonprofit sector.
   

  

 This is a doer's role. Most of your time will be spent building, configuring, testing and deploying, turning designs from the Technical Lead and Technical Architect into high\-quality working solutions.
   

  

 Our delivery philosophy is
 **out\-of\-the\-box first** 
 . We favour standard features, configuration and low\-code tools, and only build custom where it earns its place. When custom is needed, you will have the depth in Apex, Lightning Web Components and integrations to build it well.
   

  

 We are looking for a quality engineer who takes pride in their work, owns their deliverables end to end and speaks up when something doesn't look right.
   

  

**Key responsibilities**
**Build and configure**
* Deliver user stories end to end, from understanding acceptance criteria through build, unit testing and deployment.
* Configure standard features first: objects, record types, Dynamic Forms, validation rules, Flow, Experience Builder and Nonprofit Cloud standard processes.
* Build custom functionality where needed in Apex (triggers, batch, queueable, scheduled), Lightning Web Components and complex Flows.
* Build and extend Experience Cloud sites (LWR and Aura), including guest and authenticated access, sharing sets and custom components.
* Develop integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events and Named Credentials, following the designs set by the Technical Lead and Technical Architect.
* Support data migration activity: scripting, loading, validation and reconciliation.


**Quality and DevOps**
* Write clean, well\-tested, governor\-limit\-safe code that follows team standards and patterns.
* Participate in peer code reviews, giving and receiving constructive feedback.
* Work within Git\-based source control and CI/CD pipelines (e.g. SFDX, DevOps Center, Copado, Gearset).
* Investigate and fix defects across test, UAT and production support.


**Team contribution**
* Support the Technical Lead and Technical Architect with estimates, technical spikes, proofs of concept and design input.
* Raise risks, blockers and better alternatives early rather than building to a flawed spec.
* Help and mentor junior developers and administrators.
* Work directly with UK colleagues and client stakeholders in refinement, demos and UAT sessions.
* Produce clear technical documentation for what you build.


**Essential skills and experience**
* 4\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce development experience.
* A strong out\-of\-the\-box\-first mindset, with a track record of solving problems through configuration and low\-code before writing code.
* Strong, current skills in Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components, JavaScript and Flow.
* Hands\-on experience building Experience Cloud sites, including external user security and sharing.
* Solid understanding of the Core Platform: data modelling, sharing and visibility, permission sets and governor limits.
* Experience building and consuming REST/SOAP integrations.
* Comfortable with Salesforce DX, Git and CI/CD tooling.
* Experience working directly with onshore (ideally UK) teams and clients, with excellent written and spoken English.
* Takes ownership of their work, asks good questions and challenges constructively.
* Willing to provide regular overlap with UK working hours.


**Desirable skills and experience**
* **Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud** 
 — hands\-on build experience with the current data model (Person Accounts, Fundraising, Gift Entry, Program and Case Management, Volunteer Management, Outcome Management).
* Experience with the legacy Nonprofit Success Pack (NPSP) or NPSP to Nonprofit Cloud migrations.
* Awareness of UK nonprofit needs such as Gift Aid and GDPR consent management.
* OmniStudio (FlexCards, OmniScripts, Integration Procedures, Data Mappers).
* Experience integrating payment, marketing or finance platforms.
* Exposure to Data Cloud or Agentforce.
* Accessibility (WCAG) experience on public\-facing sites.


**Certifications**
**Essential:** 
 Platform Developer I.
   

  

**Desirable:**
* Platform Developer II
* Platform App Builder or Administrator
* JavaScript Developer I
* Experience Cloud Consultant
* Nonprofit Cloud Consultant
* OmniStudio Developer

title: Senior Manager, App Dev & Support
description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission\-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments \- creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Senior Technical Architect (Application Modernization)**
 We are seeking a visionary Technical Architect with a deep background in Application Modernization to lead a critical digital transformation. This role is focused on deconstructing a legacy 2\-tier architecture and rebuilding it into a scalable, high\-performance N\-tier system.
   

  

 You will be the bridge between the past and the future—moving our logic out of SQL stored procedures and migrating our legacy C\# frontend into a modern, responsive React/Redux ecosystem.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Architectural Strategy: Define the roadmap for migrating a monolithic 2\-tier application (Client/Server) to a decoupled, N\-tier architecture.
* Legacy Deconstruction: Analyze legacy C\# codebases and complex SQL stored procedures to identify business logic for extraction.
* Modernization Execution: Lead the shift of business logic from the database layer into a dedicated C\#/.NET Business Logic Layer (BLL) or Microservices.
* Frontend Leadership: Direct the transition from legacy UI to a modern React.js frontend, utilizing Redux for robust state management using Vite, Material UI, Redux Toolkit, React Query, React Hook Form, and Styled Components/SCSS.
* Ensure cross\-browser compatibility, visual consistency, and WCAG accessibility compliance.
* API Design: Architect and implement secure, RESTful APIs that serve as the communication backbone between the new frontend and the re\-engineered backend.
* Technical Governance: Establish coding standards, design patterns (e.g., Repository, Unit of Work), and CI/CD pipelines tailored for modernization projects.


**Technical Requirements**
 Category Requirements Modernization Proven experience moving logic from Stored Procedures to Application Code (Refactoring the "Smart Database" anti\-pattern). Frontend Expert\-level proficiency in React.js, Redux / Redux Toolkit, Vite, Material UI, React Query, React Hook Form, and Styled Components/SCSS and modern CSS frameworks (Bootstrap). Backend Strong mastery of C\# and .NET (6/7/8/9\+), specifically in building Web APIs and Service Layers (must have strong hands\-on experience in RestSharp, Dapper, Fluent Validations etc.). Database Deep understanding of SQL Server; ability to read/debug complex legacy T\-SQL and optimize new schemas. Architecture Solid grasp of N\-tier architecture, Dependency Injection, and Microservices patterns. Cloud/Containerization Expert\-level proficiency in Cloud (Azure), Docker and Kubernetes. Cache Mechanism Strong mastery in Redis for Cache Management
   

  

**Experience \& Qualifications**
* Modernization Veteran: 15\+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5\+ years specifically leading Legacy\-to\-Modern migration projects.
* The "2\-to\-N" Specialist: Demonstrated success in breaking down 2\-tier "Fat Client" or "Fat DB" systems into modular N\-tier environments.
* Strategic Thinker: Ability to balance "perfect" architecture with business continuity.
* Communication: Ability to explain technical debt and architectural ROI to stakeholders who may only see the UI changes.
* Industry certifications would definitely be considered.


 Conduent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, national origin, age, gender identity, gender expression, sex/gender, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, use of a guide dog or service animal, military/veteran status, citizenship status, basis of genetic information, or any other group protected by law.

title: Software Development Engineer, Time & Pay Innovation
description:
**Description**
 Amazon is one of the largest employers on the planet with hundreds of thousands of employees across the globe. Come join us in our journey to deliver solutions for one of the most complex domains in People eXperience Technology (PXT). Your code determines how Amazon associates get paid — accurately, on time, every single day. As an SDE\-II in TAA, you own and deliver features across one of Amazon's most critical real\-time platforms: a high\-throughput, event\-driven architecture processing millions of IoT punch events globally. You don't just write code — you own systems. We own and deliver technology to manage employee time expectations and compute their pay, globally, for all our current and emerging businesses. At the core, we are in the business of analytics — real\-time and event\-driven — of data collected from IoT devices (time clocks) and web user interfaces. We own our own high\-availability services to support this processing, and require the ability to work from replay\-able, auditable "truth" for any point in an employee's timeline. Our business rules are complex and arcane, varying by role, business, and jurisdiction. We are solving all these problems at Amazon scale, an order of magnitude larger than supported by any commodity solutions and growing exponentially.
   

  

 We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II who is a strong, independent builder with growing design maturity. You take ownership of significant features and components, drive them from design through production, and operate them with high standards. You write high\-quality code, make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade\-offs, and proactively improve the systems you touch. You are developing your ability to influence design direction, mentor junior engineers, and think beyond your immediate deliverables to the health of the broader system.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the design and delivery of significant features and components across scalable, multi\-tiered applications and services. Drive projects from requirements through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operation.


 Write high\-quality, well\-tested production code using modern languages, design patterns, and frameworks. Hold yourself and your peers to high standards through thorough code reviews.
   

  

* Make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade\-offs. Evaluate options for caching, retry strategies, concurrency, and data modeling. Justify your choices and communicate trade\-offs clearly.


 Design and build for scale and resilience. Consider failure modes, rate limits, traffic bursts, and downstream dependency health in your designs. Implement patterns like backpressure, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation.
   

  

* Own operational excellence for your systems. Monitor production health, respond to alarms, investigate root causes, and drive fixes. Write runbooks, improve observability, and reduce operational burden over time.


 Contribute to system\-level design discussions. Participate actively in design reviews — propose solutions, challenge assumptions, and help the team arrive at better architectures.
   

  

 Mentor junior engineers. Support SDE\-Is through code reviews, pairing sessions, and technical guidance. Help them grow their skills and develop good engineering habits.
   

  

* Understand and translate business requirements. Work with stakeholders to understand complex domain rules across punch processing, attendance, scheduling, and compliance. Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs.


 Identify and resolve technical debt proactively. Improve code quality, simplify complex logic, optimize performance, and refactor systems to support future growth — without being asked.
   

  

 Contribute to team processes and culture. Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and on\-call rotations. Raise the bar for engineering practices and help improve team velocity.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 You start the day reviewing a design you wrote for a new feature in the compliance system — incorporating feedback from a senior engineer on edge cases around jurisdiction\-specific rules. You update the design, get alignment, and start building. Mid\-morning, you review a code change from a junior engineer, leaving constructive feedback on error handling and test coverage. After lunch, you investigate a latency spike in one of your services — tracing requests through logs and metrics, identifying a downstream throttling issue, and implementing a retry optimization. You join a design review for a cross\-team project, asking questions about failure modes and proposing an alternative caching approach. You close the day deploying your feature to a pre\-production environment, validating metrics, and updating the team on progress in standup.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are Time and Attendance (TAA) team within People eXperience Technology (PXT). Our team builds and operates the technology that powers how Amazon tracks, manages, and compensates employee time — globally, across all business lines and geographies.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience
* 1\+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

* Troubleshoot and debug customer reported as well as internal issues, identify and implement solutions to ensure optimal functionality.
* Stay updated with industry trends and emerging technologies to continuously improve the software development process and enhance product quality.
* Take part in the journey to move the product further towards a Cloud Native solution.
* Suggest innovative solutions to technical challenges and continuously involve in improvements.


**Desired Experience**
 From most to least important:
   

  

* You can demonstrate examples of design and strong coding skills in multiple languages, one of which must be C\#, with 10\+ years of hands\-on experience.
* Expertise on clean code, SOLID principles, and design patterns.
* Good Understanding of data structures and algorithms
* Proficiency in MVVM (Model\-View\-ViewModel) design pattern, and WPF data binding.
* Developing RESTful or SOAP APIs.
* Experience in system design or architectural work
* Oracle or any other RDBMS or NoSQL database
* Able to coach and mentor colleagues with less experience.
* Any ORM framework like Entity Framework or Nhibernate.
* Any other version control system such as GIT.
* Angular framework (Angular 2\+).
* Azure CI/CD pipeline or any other CI/CD pipeline.
* Containerization technology such as Docker or Podman.
* Code analysis tools (such as SonarQube, ReSharper, or similar)
* Good communication skills, working with a broad range of people, including Product Owners, Architects, Testers.
* Software development methodologies and processes like Agile, SCRUM, Kanban.
* Good Understanding of AWS/Azure/GCP services and cloud architecture.
* Test Driven Development, Unit testing
* Positive approach to problem solving with a ‘can do’ attitude.


**Great Skills To Have**
* Associate\-level cloud certification in AWS or Azure (or higher), preferred.
* Familiarity with AI tools like GitHub Copilot, LLMs
* Experience in Industrial domain like Oil and Gas, EPCs, Marine will be preferred.


**The team you’ll join.**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and collaborative software developer to join our open and feedback\-focused team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a group of individuals who value the exchange of ideas and constructive feedback, and who operate in an environment where open communication and transparency are encouraged. Our team is focused on continuous improvement and learning, and we embrace a culture of experimentation, where new and innovative approaches are encouraged.
   

  

**R\&D at AVEVA**
 Our global team of 2000\+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.
   

  

 Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/r\-and\-d\-careers/
   

  

**India Benefits include:**
 Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well\-being support
   

  

 It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
   

  

**Hybrid working**
 By default, employees are expected to be in their local AVEVA office three days a week, but some positions are fully office\-based. Roles supporting particular customers or markets are sometimes remote.
   

  

**Hiring process**
 Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring\-process
   

  

**About AVEVA**
 AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting\-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
   

  

 We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability\-report.aveva.com/
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/

Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third\-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.

title: Software Architect, Enterprise Mobile Applications
description:
**About ValGenesis**
 ValGenesis is a leading digital validation platform provider for life sciences companies. ValGenesis suite of products are used by 30 of the top 50 global pharmaceutical and biotech companies to achieve digital transformation, total compliance and manufacturing excellence/intelligence across their product lifecycle.
   

  

 Learn more about working for ValGenesis, the de facto standard for paperless validation in Life Sciences: https://www.valgenesis.com/about
   

  

 About the Role:
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced and visionary Mobile application development architect to lead the design and development of our enterprise mobile applications. The Mobile Architect will be responsible for defining and implementing architectural solutions that align with our business goals and technological standards. This role requires a deep understanding of mobile platforms, a strong technical background, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design scalable, high\-performance mobile application architectures that meet both functional and non\-functional requirements and integrate with backend systems, APIs, and cloud services
* Provide technical leadership on memory management, performance optimization, and security best practices for React Native apps
* Develop strategies for efficient handling of multiple device form factors and OS versions
* Oversee CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes for both iOS and Android platforms
* Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, and development teams to gather requirements and translate them into robust mobile solutions
* Evaluate and recommend mobile technologies, frameworks, and tools to enhance development efficiency and app performance
* Architect the enterprise mobile platform and applications leveraging Azure cloud services, Microservices/APIs, DevSecOps, CI/CD, NoCode platform principles
* Own and be accountable for the Performance, Scalability, Reliability and Sustainability of the platform/product architecture
* Define Mobile application development best practices and architectural patterns
* Optimize the performance of applications across various devices and OS versions
* Conduct code reviews to ensure that development practices align with architectural guidelines and best practices
* Communicate architectural decisions and technical concepts effectively to stakeholders, including non\-technical audiences


**Requirements**
* 12\+ years of hands\-on experience in architecting and developing enterprise mobile software products (iOS, Windows, Android, native and cross\-platform) and the frameworks/platforms
* Experience in building MEAP (Mobile Enterprise Application Platform) that enables faster and scalable development of cross\-platform mobile applications and consumption/integration of the backend enterprise services
* Proficiency in programming languages relevant to mobile development (e.g., Swift, Kotlin, Java)
* Extensive experience with React Native, RESTful APIs, Azure Cloud Services and DevOps
* Strong knowledge of Enterprise Mobile architecture – Offline\-First
* Strong knowledge of Microservices, low code development, reusable component development
* Strong knowledge of Distribution, Security principles/techniques \- data and the app interfaces
* Strong knowledge of EMM/MDM
* Expertise in designing and optimizing local data storage for mobile apps, considering performance, memory management, and battery usage
* Strong knowledge of mobile app architecture patterns (e.g., MVVM, MVP, MVC)
* Expertise in state management solutions \- Redux, MobX, Recoil etc
* Experience in container\-based development, AKS, Service Fabric etc
* Strong experience in data structures, architectural patterns and system design
* Strong understanding of mobile security best practices, including data encryption, secure storage, and authentication protocols
* Knowledge of performance profiling tools and techniques
* Experience in RDBMS, NoSQL, MongoDB, Realm, SQLite data base design and development
* Good Knowledge of Code Quality, Code Monitoring, Performance Engineering, Test Automation Tools


**We’re on a Mission**
 In 2005, we disrupted the life sciences industry by introducing the world’s first digital validation lifecycle management system. ValGenesis VLMS® revolutionized compliance\-based corporate validation activities and has remained the industry standard.
   

  

 Today, we continue to push the boundaries of innovation ― enhancing and expanding our portfolio beyond validation with an end\-to\-end digital transformation platform. We combine our purpose\-built systems with world\-class consulting services to help every facet of GxP meet evolving regulations and quality expectations.
   

  

**The Team You’ll Join**
 Our customers’ success is our success. We keep the customer experience centered in our decisions, from product to marketing to sales to services to support. Life sciences companies exist to improve humanity’s quality of life, and we honor that mission.
   

  

 We work together. We communicate openly, support each other without reservation, and never hesitate to wear multiple hats to get the job done.
   

  

 We think big. Innovation is the heart of ValGenesis. That spirit drives product development as well as personal growth. We never stop aiming upward.
   

  

 We’re in it to win it. We’re on a path to becoming the number one intelligent validation platform in the market, and we won’t settle for anything less than being a market leader.
   

  

**How We Work**
 Our Chennai, Hyderabad and Bangalore offices are onsite, 5 days per week. We believe that in\-person interaction and collaboration fosters creativity, and a sense of community, and is critical to our future success as a company.
   

  

 ValGenesis is an equal\-opportunity employer that makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. Our goal is to have the best\-qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristics protected by local law.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Salesforce Technical Lead
description:
**Salesforce Technical Lead** 




**Who We Are: (
 
 www.credera.com
 
 )** 




 Credera, trading as TA Digital, is a global consulting firm that combines transformational consulting capabilities, deep industry knowledge, and AI and technology expertise to deliver valuable customer experience and accelerated growth across a broad range of industries worldwide. Our one\-of\-a\-kind global boutique approach means we provide our clients with tailored solutions unique to their organization that can scale due to our extensive footprint. As a values\-led organization, our mission is to make an extraordinary impact on our clients, our people, and our community. We believe it is this approach that has allowed us to work with and transform the most influential brands and organizations in the world, from strategy through to execution.
 



 More information is available at www.credera.com. We are part of the OPMG Group of Companies, a division of Omnicom Group Inc.
 



  





**Job Title: Salesforce Technical Lead** 




**Job Type: Full\-time** 




**Work Mode: Hybrid (3 Days per week Work From Office)** 




**Location: Hyderabad** 




  





**About the Role:** 




 We are hiring a hands\-on Salesforce Technical Lead, based in India, to work alongside our India\-based Technical Architect on Salesforce Core Platform and Experience Cloud solutions for our clients, with a strong focus on the nonprofit sector.
 



 This is a player\-coach role, not a ticket\-taking one. You will be a trusted extension of the Technical Architect: shaping designs, making sound day\-to\-day technical decisions and owning the quality of what the team builds.
 



 Our delivery philosophy is
 **out\-of\-the\-box first** 
 . We favour standard features, configuration and low\-code tools, and only build custom where it earns its place. You still need deep technical skills — Apex, Lightning Web Components and integrations — to know when custom is justified, to build it well, and to challenge poor designs.
 



 We are looking for a quality engineer who takes ownership and thinks like a consultant. You will work directly with onshore colleagues and client stakeholders as a full member of the delivery team.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




 Most solutions will be configuration\-led; the technical responsibilities below describe the depth you need to be able to call on when a requirement demands it.
 



**Technical leadership and design** 



* Support the Technical Architect in shaping and owning the technical solution across Sales/Service Cloud core, Experience Cloud and Nonprofit Cloud, from discovery through go\-live and hypercare.
* Translate business requirements into scalable designs: data model, security and sharing, automation, integration and Experience Cloud site architecture.
* Apply an out\-of\-the\-box\-first approach, making and documenting build decisions vs. programmatic, standard vs. custom, managed package vs. native — with clear trade\-offs.
* Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, naming conventions and governor\-limit\-safe practices.
* Deputize for the Technical Architect in design sessions and technical governance when needed, and escalate risks early.



**Hands\-on delivery** 



* Configure standard features first: record types, page layouts, Dynamic Forms, validation rules, Flow, Experience Builder and Nonprofit Cloud standard processes.
* Build complex functionality in Apex (triggers, batch, queueable, scheduled), Lightning Web Components and Flow.
* Design and build Experience Cloud sites (LWR and Aura) for donors, volunteers, beneficiaries, members or partners, including guest and authenticated user access, sharing sets and custom themes.
* Deliver integrations with finance, payment, marketing and data platforms using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Named Credentials and middleware (e.g. MuleSoft).
* Lead data migrations, including legacy CRM or NPSP to Nonprofit Cloud, with robust mapping, cleansing and reconciliation.



**DevOps and quality** 



* Own the release process: source control (Git), CI/CD pipelines (e.g. Salesforce DevOps Center, Copado, Gearset, SFDX), environment and sandbox strategy.
* Ensure high\-quality, well\-tested code with meaningful unit test coverage, peer code reviews and automated quality checks.
* Champion security, performance and accessibility (WCAG) across internal and public\-facing sites.



**Team and client leadership** 



* Lead, mentor and review the work of developers and administrators; run technical stand\-ups and design reviews.
* Act as the senior technical voice with client stakeholders, from product owners to IT leadership.
* Support pre\-sales: technical scoping, estimation, solution outlines and client presentations.
* Keep up with Salesforce releases (including Agentforce and Data Cloud) and advise clients on the roadmap.



**Essential skills and experience** 



* A strong out\-of\-the\-box\-first mindset, with a track record of solving problems through configuration and low\-code before writing code.
* 5\+ years of Salesforce experience, including at least 2 years leading technical delivery on multi\-workstream projects.
* Expert, current hands\-on skills in Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components and Flow.
* Proven delivery of Experience Cloud sites end to end, including licensing models, external user security, sharing sets, audiences, CMS and performance tuning.
* Deep knowledge of the Core Platform: data modelling, sharing and visibility, profiles and permission sets, large data volumes and governor limits.
* Strong integration experience: REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, OAuth flows and Named Credentials.
* Hands\-on with Salesforce DX, Git\-based source control and CI/CD tooling.
* Experience leading and mentoring developers, running code reviews and setting technical standards.
* Confident communicator who can explain technical trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Consulting or client\-facing delivery experience in an Agile environment.
* Proven experience working directly with onshore (ideally UK or European) teams and clients, with excellent written and spoken English.
* Takes ownership of outcomes, raises concerns proactively and is comfortable challenging requirements or designs constructively.
* Willing to provide regular overlap with UK working hours.



**Desirable skills and experience** 



* **Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud** 
 — hands\-on implementation of the current Nonprofit Cloud data model (Person Accounts, Fundraising, Gift Entry, Program and Case Management, Volunteer Management, Outcome Management, Grantmaking).
* Experience with the legacy Nonprofit Success Pack (NPSP) and migrating clients from NPSP to Nonprofit Cloud.
* Understanding of UK nonprofit needs such as Gift Aid, GDPR and consent management, and supporter journeys.
* Experience with nonprofit\-adjacent tools: payment and giving platforms, Marketing Cloud or Account Engagement, and finance system integrations.
* OmniStudio (FlexCards, OmniScripts, Integration Procedures, DataRaptors/Data Mappers), which underpins much of Nonprofit Cloud.
* Exposure to Data Cloud, Agentforce or Tableau/CRM Analytics or other middleware experience.



**Certifications** 




**Essential:** 
 Platform Developer I and Platform App Builder (or Administrator).
 



**Desirable:** 



* Platform Developer II
* Experience Cloud Consultant
* Nonprofit Cloud Consultant
* JavaScript Developer I
* Application Architect or System Architect credentials
* OmniStudio Developer or Consultant

title: Technical Lead
description:
Technical Lead \- Full Stack (7\+ years) / Full\-time
 



 Hyderabad (Onsite)
 



 About SpeEdLabs
 



 Founded in 2015 by IIT Kanpur \& IIM Lucknow alumni, SpeEdLabs is a smart learning platform that uses a combination of Artificial Intelligence \& Adaptive Learning to ensure personalized learning for each student. This hybrid approach or the SpeEdLabs advantage focuses on deep conceptual learning to enable real\-world application, particularly in the Science \& Mathematics for K12 \& competitive examinations.
 



 The AI\-based practice platform is built to enhance foundational concept\-based learning by using a blend of modern teaching techniques, technically\- calibrated practice sessions and most of all \- a personalized approach. The platform functions on a robust technological framework that helps identify areas of improvement for every student and build learning strategies based on these insights.
 



 Currently present in 200\+ cities, enabling 200,000\+ students and 15,000 teachers, SpeEdLabs complements offline tutorials to shift towards a HYBRID LEARNING MODEL whilst continuing to teach in their old way, allowing students to seek more benefit from the platform and for institutes to scale better.
 



 About the Role
 



 We are looking for a Technical Lead to own the SpeEdLabs product end to end \- a Python/FastAPI backend running large API operations across 30\+ product domains over Microsoft SQL Server and MongoDB, and a Vue.js mobile\-first application used every day by students, teachers, school administrators and coaching institutes across India.
 



 This is a hands\-on role, not a management one. You will spend most of your week writing and reviewing production code. The rest of it goes into raising the bar for a young engineering team \- shaping the design before the code gets written, reviewing what the juniors ship, and making sure the architecture holds as the product grows. If you want to keep building while you build a team, this is the seat.
 



 What You’ll Build
 



 ● Adaptive practice and assessments \- assignments, tests, self\-practice and offline OMR\-based exams, from design through conduct through auto\-evaluation.
 



 ● Students’ learning journey insights that turns every question attempt into chapter\-, topic\- and concept\-level mastery signals, and drives what each student sees next.
 



 ● An advanced content platform spanning Course → Subject → Chapter → Topic → Concept
 



 → Question, with AI\-assisted authoring, question digitisation from PDFs at scale, lectures,
 



 videos, expansive teaching content libraries, QR codes for smart books.
 



 ● AI in production \- Google Gemini and OpenAI driving content generation, PDF extraction and
 



 automated evaluation, on async batch pipelines rather than toy prompts.
 



 ● School and institute operations \- Complete LMS, batch management, school health scores,
 



 field\-visit, ticketing and reporting workflows for the teams running our on\-ground business.
 



 ● Live and interactive learning \- Zoom classes, live streaming, interactive video authoring,
 



 and a learning bot that reaches students and parents where they already are.
 



 What You’ll Do
 



 ● Design and build features end to end \- from data model and API contract on the FastAPI
 



 backend through to the Vue.js interface the user actually touches.
 



 ● Own the data layer: SQLAlchemy models over Microsoft SQL Server and document models
 



 over MongoDB, with the judgement to know which data belongs where.
 



 ● Write and tune queries that stay fast at production scale \- our analytics and reporting
 



 surfaces read across millions of student attempt records.
 



 ● Build and maintain asynchronous background processing: scheduled jobs, Azure Service Bus
 



 queue workers, PDF report generation, OMR scanning and AI content pipelines.
 



 ● Write efficient, reusable, testable Python, JavaScript and SQL
 



 ● Take production issues personally: debug, root\-cause and fix, then close the gap that led to
 



 the bug.
 



 How You’ll Lead
 



 ● Translate product goals into a technical approach, then into tasks a team of 5 junior
 



 engineers can pick up and finish without ambiguity.
 



 ● Review the code that goes into the product \- for correctness, performance, security and
 



 convention adherence \- and give feedback that teaches rather than just corrects.
 



 ● Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers: pair on the hard problems, unblock them early, and
 



 grow them into people who need less of your time.
 



 ● Set and hold engineering standards \- coding conventions, testing, code review, release
 



 process and documentation \- and make them stick.
 



 ● Make architectural calls on schema design, service boundaries and build\-vs\-buy, and write
 



 down the reasoning so the next engineer inherits the decision, not just the code.
 



 ● Work directly with the founders, product and business stakeholders to turn a business goal
 



 into shippable scope \- and to push back when the scope and the timeline disagree.
 



 ● Own delivery for your pod: estimates that hold, releases that surprise nobody, and
 



 accountability for what you ship.
 



 Who You Are
 



 ● 7\+ years building and shipping production grade mobile\-first web applications, including at least 2 years leading, mentoring or formally reviewing other engineers’ work.
 



 ● Strong in Python, with real depth in a modern web framework \- FastAPI preferred; solid Django or Flask experience counts if you are ready to move.
 



 ● Strong in JavaScript (ES6\+) and a modern SPA framework \- Vue.js preferred; React or Angular experience counts if you are ready to move.
 



 ● Genuine SQL depth: schema design, indexing, execution plans, and the instinct to spot an N\+1 before it reaches production.
 



 ● Hands\-on with an ORM at scale \- SQLAlchemy preferred \- plus comfort with NoSQL document modelling (MongoDB).
 



 ● REST API design you can defend: resource modelling, versioning, status codes, pagination and backward compatibility.
 



 ● Cloud experience \- Azure (Functions, Blob Storage, Service Bus) preferred; equivalent AWS or GCP depth is fine.
 



 ● A track record of raising a team’s standard, not just out\-performing it \- your code reviews should be something juniors look forward to.
 



 ● Clear written communication: you can explain a design decision to an engineer and its business consequence to a founder, in the same week.
 



 ● Strong planning, problem solving and organizational skills, along with a demonstrable self\-drive and motivation.
 



 ● Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering field or equivalent practical experience.
 



 Good To Have
 



 ● Production experience building with LLMs \- prompt design, structured output, batch/async inference and evaluating output quality.
 



 ● Depth in async Python: concurrency, queue\-driven architectures and long\-running background workers.
 



 ● Database migration practice at scale (Alembic or equivalent) against a live, customer\-facing database.
 



 ● Experience with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) inside a disciplined engineering workflow \- we use them heavily, with review rigour around them.
 



 ● Exposure to document and image processing \- OCR, OMR, PDF extraction, LaTeX.
 



 ● CI/CD, observability and incident\-response ownership.
 



 ● EdTech, assessment or learning\-analytics domain experience.

**Position Summary:**
