title: Senior Salesforce Technical Consultant – Life Sciences
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

******About Salesforce******
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

****About Salesforce****
**We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI \+ Data \+ CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good – you’ve come to the right place.**
**Salesforce Technical Consultants deliver solutions that transform our customers’ businesses and their customers’ experiences. In the Life Sciences vertical, this role involves partnering with project teams and client stakeholders to discover, design, code, and deploy specialized Salesforce Platform and Industry solutions (including Life Sciences Cloud and Health Cloud) tailored for pharmaceutical, biotech, medtech, and healthcare organizations.**
**Approximately 70–75% of this role involves hands\-on programming and system integration using Apex, JavaScript, Lightning Web Components (LWC), OmniStudio, and REST/SOAP APIs, while ensuring compliance with stringent regulatory standards.**
**The ideal technical consultant is a demonstrated practitioner and emerging thought leader who bridges deep Salesforce development capabilities with domain understanding of regulated industries. You will evaluate implementation options, build scalable architectures, guide client technical teams, proactively manage risk areas, and commit to seeing complex engineering challenges through to resolution.**
**YOUR IMPACT: Responsibilities**
* Hands\-on Development \& Customization: Code enterprise\-grade solutions using Salesforce Apex, JavaScript, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and modern web frameworks integrated with middleware and core Life Sciences backend systems.
* Domain \& Regulatory Solutioning: Implement Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Health Cloud, and OmniStudio features that comply with strict industry regulatory and security frameworks (e.g., HIPAA, GxP, PHI).
* AI\-First Workflow Execution: Champion an AI\-first development workflow by leveraging advanced AI developer tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate custom Apex, LWC, and integration delivery while maintaining platform governor limits and security compliance.
* Architecture \& Data Modeling: Define and build secure, scalable data models (1:M, M:M relationships), sharing rules, security models, and object structures optimized for Life Sciences and Healthcare workflows.
* Integrations \& Interoperability: Build, optimize, and document API\-based integrations connecting Salesforce to enterprise platforms, EHR/EMR systems, and middleware standard tools (utilizing HL7/FHIR standards where applicable).
* Technical Leadership \& Workshops: Facilitate functional and technical workshops, review user stories, map end\-to\-end user journeys, and apply modern Apex and UI design patterns to solve complex business requirements.
* Delivery \& Best Practices: Adhere to Salesforce Services development best practices, participate in DevOps/release management workflows, and drive high Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) scores.
* Travel: Travel to client sites as required by engagement scope (average of 50%, varying based on project needs).


****MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS****
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent.
* 5\+ years of technology development experience, with 3\+ years in client\-facing consulting or system implementation roles.
* Strong object\-oriented programming experience (Apex, Java, C\#, or Python) alongside fluent JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and web component engineering.
* Proven hands\-on experience designing data models, custom logic, and platform integrations on the Salesforce ecosystem.
* Foundational domain awareness of Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Medical Devices, or Healthcare Providers, including exposure to compliance constraints (HIPAA, GxP, PHI).
* Experience with API integrations (REST, SOAP, JSON, XML) and system security protocols.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex requirements, design adaptable technical solutions, and work independently as a self\-starter.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with client facilitation experience.


****PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS****
* Salesforce Product Expertise: Prior development experience with Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Health Cloud, OmniStudio framework, or Veeva CRM.
* Healthcare Interoperability: Experience with healthcare data standards and protocols such as HL7 and FHIR.
* Certifications: Highly beneficial to hold existing Salesforce certifications upon joining. Success in this role includes acquiring core certifications within the onboarding phase:
+ Salesforce Certified Administrator
+ Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder
+ Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I
+ Salesforce Certified JavaScript Developer I
+ Salesforce Health Cloud Accredited / OmniStudio Developer (Bonus)

* DevOps \& Integration Skills: Experience with CI/CD tools, version control (Git), automated testing frameworks, and middleware platforms (e.g., MuleSoft).
* AI Tooling Fluency: Practical experience using AI coding assistants to optimize daily development velocity, document custom code, and automate repetitive engineering tasks.


**ATTRIBUTES**
* Consultative Leader: Ability to clearly communicate the business and technical value of Salesforce platform features to both business stakeholders and client engineering teams.
* Results\-Driven: Tenacious and focused on delivering high\-quality, maintainable code in fast\-paced environments.
* Adaptable Learner: Quick to master emerging platform updates, regulatory guidelines, and AI development techniques.
* Collaborative \& Positive: Solves complex multi\-system challenges with a constructive, solution\-oriented mindset that motivates team members.


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
   

  

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
   

  

 Posting Statement
   

  

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Technical Implementation, Senior Technical Consultant
description:
**Senior Consultant – Offshore FinTech \- Technical Consultant,**
**Charles River Development \| Engineering / Professional Services**
****Role Summary****
 Senior Consultants – Offshore are responsible for the end‑to‑end technical implementation of the Investment Management Solution Application.
   

  

 This role requires strong domain and product expertise combined with hands‑on technical skills to translate client business requirements into scalable, production‑ready solutions.
   

  

 Senior Consultants should design, configure, develop, and integrate CRIMS components while ensuring solution quality, system stability, and operational readiness. The role involves close collaboration with clients, project managers, architects, and global delivery teams to ensure successful implementation and client ownership post go‑live.
   

  

****What We Are Looking For****
 We are seeking experienced implementation professionals with a strong background in
 **investment management systems and financial technology delivery** 
 . The ideal candidate brings
 **at least 12 years of relevant industry experience** 
 , gained within a consulting firm or financial software provider, and has successfully delivered complex
 **Front, Middle, or Back Office** 
 implementations.
   

  

 Candidates with proven experience in
 **Capital Markets technology projects** 
 , strong technical depth, and a track record of client‑facing delivery will thrive in this role.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
 As a Senior Consultant – Offshore, you will:
   

  

* Lead and contribute to CRIMS technical implementations across Front, Middle, and Back Office workflows
* Analyze, validate, and translate business and technical requirements into effective CRIMS solutions
* Design, configure, and develop application components aligned with functional and non‑functional requirements
* Perform end‑to‑end system testing, including integration and regression testing across workflows
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across application, data, and integration layers
* Ensure solutions are stable, scalable, and production ready, meeting CRD engineering and client standards
* Partner with clients and internal stakeholders to support go‑live readiness and transition to client ownership
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior team members as required
* Contribute to delivery excellence by adhering to CRD SDLC, documentation, and quality practices


****What We Value****
 Senior Consultants (Offshore) are expected to demonstrate:
   

  

* Strong experience delivering Front, Middle, or Back Office Investment Management system implementations
* Proven execution skills with the ability to manage priorities, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations
* Deep capital markets domain knowledge, including:
+ Equity and Fixed Income instruments
+ Investment and/or Wealth Management workflows
+ Derivatives and Foreign Exchange (FX)


****Technical Skills \& Experience****
 Hands‑on technical expertise is essential, including:
   

  

* Programming \& Development
+ C\#
+ Core Java
+ SQL Server (advanced querying, performance tuning)
+ Batch Jobs
+ ETL Basics
+ Observability tools
+ AI

* Data \& Reporting
+ ETL tools such as Pentaho Kettle or Talend
+ SSRS report development
+ Data processing and reconciliation workflows

* Cloud \& Platforms
+ Strong experience with Azure and/or AWS
+ Snowflake experience is a strong plus

* Integration \& Market Data
+ Industry standards and interfaces such as FIX, SWIFT
+ Market data and reference data integrations (e.g., Bloomberg, MSCI)


****Education \& Preferred Qualifications****
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline
* Strong academic foundation in:
+ Software development and object‑oriented programming
+ Data structures and databases
+ Financial systems and distributed architecture

* Exposure to cloud computing, data integration, and enterprise systems is highly valued
* Advanced degrees or certifications are a plus, including:
+ Azure / AWS Cloud Certifications
+ Relevant technical or financial certifications
+ CFA


****Experience Requirements****
* Minimum 12\-18 years of relevant professional experience delivering financial technology solutions
* Demonstrated hands‑on experience in:
+ Application development and configuration
+ System integration and data processing
+ Reporting and analytics
+ Cloud‑based implementations within investment or capital markets environments


****About State Street****
 State Street is one of the world’s largest custodians, asset managers, and asset intelligence companies. For over 200 years, we have helped clients safeguard and grow the investments of millions of people worldwide. Our services span
 **investment servicing, data \& analytics, research, trading, and investment management** 
 .
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an inclusive, flexible, and growth‑oriented workplace. Employees benefit from competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, flexible work programs, learning platforms, and opportunities to make a meaningful impact in their communities. Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers.
   

  

 Interested in learning more about us? Visit our www.statestreet.com www.crd.com
 **LinkedIn page:** 
 State Street on LinkedIn
   

  

****About State Street****
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
   

  

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

title: Supervisor, Applications Delivery
description:
**Job Description**
 The person in this role is responsible for leading the design, delivery, implementation, and ongoing support of high\-quality application solutions. At lead/manager level, the role is accountable not only for technical execution, but also for delivery ownership, team coordination, stakeholder alignment, quality governance, operational stability, and continuous improvement across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
   

  

 The person in this role works closely with business stakeholders, architects, project managers, vendors, and cross\-functional delivery teams to translate business priorities into scalable, secure, maintainable, and business\-aligned technology solutions. The role is expected to provide technical leadership, guide team members, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure successful delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Delivery Leadership, Requirements Analysis \& Estimation**
* Lead requirement analysis discussions with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and delivery teams.
* Translate business, functional, and non\-functional requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery plan, and implementation priorities.
* Own or review effort estimation, delivery planning, resource requirements, and execution timelines for assigned initiatives.
* Identify delivery risks, dependencies, assumptions, and constraints, and drive mitigation plans with stakeholders.
* Ensure requirement documents, user stories, solution notes, and technical specifications are complete, clear, and aligned with agreed scope.


**Solution Design**
* Provide technical leadership in converting enterprise architecture and business needs into detailed solution designs and implementation plans.
* Review and approve design artifacts, workflows, integration approaches, technical specifications, and solution documentation.
* Evaluate design alternatives and guide the team toward scalable, secure, high\-performing, maintainable, and cost\-effective solutions.
* Ensure solution designs comply with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, data governance expectations, and engineering best practices.
* Lead technical discussions and design reviews with architects, vendors, project teams, and support teams.


**Application Development**
* Lead and guide application development, enhancement, configuration, integration, and maintenance activities.
* Review key technical deliverables to ensure quality, maintainability, performance, security, and alignment with agreed standards.
* Provide technical direction to developers and support team members, including code review guidance, design clarification, and issue resolution support.
* Drive reuse of components, utilities, frameworks, and automation capabilities to improve delivery efficiency and consistency.
* Balance hands\-on technical contribution with oversight of team delivery, ensuring work is completed on time and with expected quality.


**Testing \& Quality Assurance**
* Define and oversee testing strategy, test coverage, quality checkpoints, and defect management for assigned solutions.
* Ensure unit, integration, system, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing activities are planned and executed effectively.
* Review high\-impact defects, support root cause analysis, and ensure corrective actions are implemented before production release.
* Promote test automation, continuous quality improvement, and proactive quality assurance practices across the delivery team.
* Ensure solutions meet functional, non\-functional, compliance, and operational readiness expectations before deployment.


**Architecture \& Technical Governance**
* Lead or actively govern application architecture, technical design, and solution review activities for assigned applications or projects.
* Ensure delivery teams follow architectural guidelines, technology standards, security policies, coding standards, and documentation expectations.
* Participate in governance forums and provide clear recommendations on solution risks, trade\-offs, dependencies, and mitigation options.
* Drive technical decision\-making in alignment with enterprise architecture, business priorities, operational impact, and long\-term maintainability.


**Release, Deployment \& Implementation**
* Own or coordinate release planning, environment readiness, deployment preparation, and implementation activities.
* Manage release risks, change approvals, production validation, rollback planning, and go\-live readiness with project and support teams.
* Coordinate application rollouts, stakeholder communication, hypercare planning, and post\-deployment stabilization.
* Ensure project is completed with proper documentation, monitoring, support handover, and minimal operational risk.


**Production Support \& Maintenance**
* Lead production support coordination for assigned applications, including incident triage, escalation, stakeholder communication, and service restoration.
* Review critical incidents, drive root cause analysis, and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Monitor application stability, performance, SLA adherence, operational risks, and recurring issue patterns.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, vendors, business users, and support teams to resolve issues within agreed timelines.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce recurring incidents, improve support efficiency, and strengthen operational resilience.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as a primary point of contact for business stakeholders, customers, vendors, project managers, and support teams for assigned applications or delivery scope.
* Facilitate effective communication between business and IT teams, ensuring expectations, priorities, risks, and decisions are clearly understood.
* Provide timely, accurate, and management\-ready updates on project progress, production issues, risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
* Lead stakeholder workshops, solution walkthroughs, demonstrations, implementation discussions, and operational readiness reviews.
* Build trusted relationships by demonstrating ownership, responsiveness, business understanding, technical credibility, and accountability.


**People Management \& Team Leadership**
* Lead, guide, mentor, and support developers, analysts, and support team members across project and operational activities.
* Allocate work, monitor progress, remove blockers, and ensure team deliverables meet agreed scope, timeline, and quality standards.
* Identify capability gaps, provide coaching, support knowledge transfer, and recommend training or development actions.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Coordinate with internal teams and vendor resources to ensure effective delivery performance and service continuity.


**Knowledge Management \& Organizational Learning**
* Own and maintain technical documentation, solution design records, support guides, runbooks, lessons learned, and reusable delivery assets.
* Establish knowledge\-sharing practices across project, development, and support teams to reduce dependency on individuals.
* Leverage lessons learned from previous projects and production issues to improve delivery effectiveness, solution quality, and operational stability.
* Conduct knowledge transfer sessions, mentor team members, and ensure transition readiness for support and maintenance teams.
* Promote continuous learning, technical capability development, and standardization across applications and technology domains.


**Transition \& Service Readiness**
* Own transition planning and service readiness for new or enhanced applications moving into production support.
* Ensure operational documentation, support guides, monitoring requirements, escalation paths, and handover materials are complete.
* Lead knowledge transfer sessions for support, maintenance, operations, and vendor teams.
* Confirm service readiness before production transition, including support model, SLA expectations, issue ownership, and operational acceptance criteria.


**Qualifications**
**Technical Skills**
* Programming in MS Visual C\#, Dot Net Framework
* Programming in RESTful API
* Coding SQL for Sql Server


**Software Engineering Processes**
* Strong working knowledge of SDLC methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, DevOps, and hybrid delivery models.
* Ability to lead delivery planning, sprint or milestone tracking, dependency management, issue resolution, and delivery governance.
* Experience establishing or enforcing engineering practices, documentation standards, quality gates, and release readiness controls.


**Design Knowledge**
* Strong understanding of architecture principles, integration patterns, design methodologies, design patterns, and anti\-patterns.
* Ability to review architectural requirements and guide teams in developing scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable technical designs.
* Experience assessing technical trade\-offs, long\-term maintainability, operational impact, and business value when recommending solutions.


**Requirements Engineering**
* Strong experience in requirements elicitation, analysis, prioritization, documentation, traceability, and stakeholder validation.
* Ability to translate business requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery roadmap, and operational support model.
* Experience managing requirement changes, business expectations, scope control, and impact assessment across project delivery phases.


**Configuration \& Release Management**
* Strong knowledge of source control, configuration management, environment management, release governance, and deployment processes.
* Experience coordinating CI/CD, build automation, deployment validation, version control, and rollback planning.
* Ability to manage release dependencies, approvals, production readiness, and post\-release stabilization activities.


**Build \& Testing Practices**
* Strong understanding of build tools, development frameworks, automation techniques, and quality engineering practices.
* Experience defining test strategy, reviewing test coverage, supporting test automation, and managing defect resolution.
* Ability to ensure software quality through structured testing, quality checkpoints, and production readiness validation.


**Behavioral Competencies**
**Analytical Thinking**
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to evaluate technical, operational, financial, and business impacts from multiple sources before recommending actions.
* Capable of assessing alternatives, facilitating alignment, and driving practical solutions under time, cost, and operational constraints.


**Communication**
* Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to communicate technical or complex topics clearly in business terms for management, business users, vendors, and technical teams.
* Able to prepare clear status updates, escalation notes, decision papers, meeting summaries, and management\-ready communications.


**Planning \& Organization**
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, resources, and operational demands in a dynamic environment.
* Proactively identifies risks, dependencies, constraints, and execution challenges, and drives mitigation with relevant stakeholders.
* Effective in planning, tracking, organizing, and coordinating deliverables across project phases, support activities, vendors, and cross\-functional teams.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Works effectively with senior stakeholders, cross\-functional teams, vendors, business users, and technical teams.
* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, customer focus, business understanding, and delivery discipline.
* Builds trust through transparency, responsiveness, sound judgment, and consistent follow\-through on commitments.


 Supports a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and team development.
   

  

**Working Experience**
* Over 8 years of relevant IT experience, including experience in application delivery, technical leadership, stakeholder management, production support, vendor coordination and team management. Prior lead or manager\-level experience is preferred.

**Description**
 Do you want to be a leader in the team that takes last mile delivery in the Transportation models to the next generation? Do you have a solid analytical thinking and want to solve problems with solutions that will meet the growing worldwide need? If you have passion to learn and be curious, and want apply your programming and analytical skills to help Amazon grow, then Last Mile Delivery Service Partner (Last Mile DSP) is the team for you. We are looking for top notch SDEs to be part of our world class software development team.
   

  

 DSP (Delivery Service Partners) are medium and large sized 3rd party businesses delivering packages from amazon last mile delivery stations to the customer on behalf of Amazon. The team’s global mission is to become Amazon’s logistics labor capacity of choice by building the provider network required to support Amazon’s growth and meet customer expectations for any deliveries, at any time of the year through scalable, innovative, and low cost operations, and in a way that both delights customers and empowers DSPs and their Delivery Associates.
   

  

 The DSP Engagement tech owns and develops technical infrastructure for a multi\-tenant omni channel platform to create and send communications across Amazon Delivery partners, delivering 100M individual notifications per year. We own the how, the when and the what of all communications sent to Amazon delivery partners.
   

  

 SDE2s in this team will be independent problem solvers creating business impact through their tech deliverables. They will learn, grow and create a lasting impact to business and their careers while having fun at work.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* You can effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions to tech and non\-tech audiences.
* You have experience with architecting systems involving data processing components, workflow orchestration and dependency management.
* You have expertise in the creation and management of backend and frontend applications and data stores, as well as proven ability to translate data into meaningful insights.

title: Senior Android Developer
description:
**Role : Senior Android Developer** 




**Location : Hyderabad, India – HYBRID** 




**Duration : 12\+ Months** 




**Interview : Video** 




  





  





  





**Why This Opportunity Stands Out** 




 This is an opportunity to contribute to the development of large\-scale, customer\-facing mobile applications used in highly visible digital environments. You will play a key role in shaping architecture, influencing technical direction, and delivering modern Android solutions built with current technologies and best practices. The position offers the chance to collaborate with experienced engineering teams while working on complex challenges related to scalability, performance, security, and user experience. Ideal for senior engineers who enjoy ownership, mentorship, and building production\-grade applications that make a meaningful impact.
 



  





**Overview** 




 Our customer is seeking a highly skilled
 **Senior Android Developer** 
 with extensive experience in designing, developing, and maintaining modern Android applications. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Kotlin, Android architecture, mobile application development, and scalable software engineering practices. This role will collaborate closely with product, design, backend engineering, and quality assurance teams to deliver high\-performing mobile solutions and help drive technical and architectural decisions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, develop, test, and maintain Android applications using Kotlin.
* Develop scalable, maintainable, and high\-quality mobile applications following modern Android development standards.
* Work extensively with Android SDK, Jetpack libraries, and Android Architecture Components.
* Design and implement clean, reusable, and testable code using established design patterns.
* Integrate RESTful APIs, JSON services, and third\-party platforms.
* Build responsive and intuitive mobile user interfaces aligned with product and UX requirements.
* Optimize application performance, memory usage, battery efficiency, and responsiveness.
* Troubleshoot complex application issues and perform root\-cause analysis.
* Develop and maintain unit, integration, and UI test coverage.
* Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and technical design sessions.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level developers.
* Collaborate closely with QA teams to resolve defects and improve software quality.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and automated mobile build and deployment processes.
* Stay current with Android technologies, frameworks, and industry best practices.
* Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and coding standards.
* **All other duties as assigned.**



**Required Qualifications** 



* 8\+ years of professional Android application development experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Kotlin.
* Deep understanding of Android SDK and Android application lifecycle.
* Experience with Jetpack components including ViewModel, StateFlow/LiveData, Room, Navigation, and WorkManager.
* Strong understanding of modern Android architecture patterns such as MVVM and Clean Architecture.
* Experience integrating REST APIs, JSON services, and HTTP\-based applications.
* Experience with Jetpack Compose and modern Android UI development.
* Knowledge of Android UI/UX principles and responsive design practices.
* Experience with dependency injection frameworks such as Hilt or Dagger.
* Strong Git and source\-control experience.
* Experience creating unit and UI tests using frameworks such as JUnit, MockK, Mockito, Espresso, or similar tools.
* Excellent debugging and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum environments.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience with Firebase and Google Play Services.
* Experience implementing mobile security and secure coding practices.
* Knowledge of OAuth 2\.0, JWT, biometric authentication, and secure data storage.
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.
* Experience with application performance monitoring and crash analytics.
* Exposure to AWS and/or Microsoft Azure cloud platforms.
* Experience supporting large\-scale customer\-facing mobile applications.
* Familiarity with modular Android architectures.
* Experience modernizing legacy Android applications to Kotlin and Jetpack\-based solutions.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field preferred.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* Strong ownership and accountability for technical deliverables.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to independently drive complex technical tasks from requirements through delivery.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to mentor engineers and influence technical decisions.
* Passion for writing clean, maintainable, and production\-ready code.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, collaborative engineering environment.
